title: General worker Pick & Pack
description:
Mission

Newrest is looking for General Workers in our Pick & Pack department who will be responsible for putting together the food trolleys for our airline client. This will include placing beverages and snacks into the food trolleys, organizing utensils and provisions and placing them in the food trolleys. This will also include organizing beverages per instructions. This individual will be standing all day. Newrest values promoting people from within. If an individual shows capability and commitment, there is opportunity for this individual to experience a career within Newrest.

Responsibilities:

  • Load carts and trolleys with platters, dishes, utensils, and containers.

  • Collect serving trays and dispose of plates in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

  • When loading trays into the trolleys, ensure they are placed appropriately within the frame of the rack.

  • Assist in setting up and packaging special meals and ingredients.

  • Complete the defined packaging schedule as assigned by supervisor or manager.

  • Edit and organize labels outside and inside for the scheduled production of the day.

  • Perform proper food packaging and storing based on safety requirements and customer instructions.

  • Tag every rack, tray, and trolley according to the company’s standards and processes.

  • Ensure that left-over ingredients and packaging material are properly labelled and returned in the dry storage, cooler or packaging material storage.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Bring trays and packaging material from the warehouse and waiting area.

  • Ensure proper and timely recording of activities.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured, and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

  • Load airline equipment with trays, dishes, utensils, and containers according to specifications provided.

  • Handle airline equipment and dispose of items in trays by following the instructions and guidelines.

  • Complete packing production of items assigned by supervisor or manager.

  • Follow all process control documentation.

  • Report any unsanitary practice and/or unsafe condition.

  • Make sure trolleys are properly identified, secured, and moved away from chemicals and hazardous substances.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

  • Follow all food safety, health and safety, company rules and standards.

  • Regular and timely attendance is expected for the position.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable requirements related to product and service quality, environmental standards, food safety, and health and safety regulations.

  • Promote a safe and healthy work environment by preventing work-related injuries and illnesses, eliminating hazards, and reducing health and safety risks.

  • Compliance with Hazard Analysis Critical Control Points (HACCP)/General manufacturing practices (GMP) guidelines for personal hygiene and observe security precautions as mandated by unit management.

  • Satisfactory and punctual attendance are expected.

Qualifications:

  • Ability to lift items/packages (up to 30 lbs)

  • Team oriented

  • Ability to handle pressure in a fast paced environment

  • Attendance, diligence, punctuality, reliability

  • Good work ethic

  • Ability to work any shift depending on operational needs.

  • English- and/or Danish speaking is a must

  • Living in Denmark or Sweden is mandatory

  • You must have a permit to work in Denmark

  • You must be able to pass a security approval process

Benefits:

  • Monthly pay

  • Special savings account (11%)

  • 13% pension

  • Paid holidays

  • Paid time off

We are looking forward to receiving your resumé.

If you haven't heard from us within 14 days after you have submitted the cv, it is because we have moved on with other candidates.

title: Agroforestry Manager til Grove Farm Management
description:
Hos Grove Farm Management bygger for fremtidens landbrug. Vi etablerer og driver produktionssystemer med træer og buske. Vi oplever stor vækst og leder efter en operationel, faglig og handlekraftig person der kan tage ansvar for plantning og drift i Midtjylland og Sønderjylland. 

Rollen 

Du bliver ansvarlig for at planlægge og etablere beplantninger med træer og buske på vores egne arealer og hos kunder. Derudover får du ansvaret for drift af vores eget skovlandbrug på 50 ha samt løbende drift-opgaver for vores kunder og samarbejdspartnere. 

Dine ansvarsområder 

  • Etablering: Lede planlægning og etablering af skovlandbrug på tværs af vores lokationer. 

  • Drift: Drift og pleje af arealer med træer. Renholdelse af beplantninger, beskæring, gødskning. Vi driver alle vores arealer økologisk. 

  • Høst: Høst af nødder, bær, frugt, gavntræ, biomasse. 

  • Planteskole: Bistå i driften af vores planteskole – fra indkøb af frømateriale og stiklinger til podning og klargøring af salgsklare træer.

  • Plantesundhed & Vedligehold: Sikre systematisk beskæring, ukrudtshåndtering og høstoptimering, så vores udbytte matcher vores kommercielle kontrakter. 

  • Udvikling og innovation: Arbejde tæt sammen med vores udviklings-team om udvikling og innovation indenfor skovlandbrug. Vi søger hele tiden at skubbe grænserne for kommercielle skovlandbrug og laver løbende markforsøg på vores kommercielle arealer og deltager i forskningsprojekter. 

  • Rundvisninger: Faciliteter rundvisninger og markvandringer for diverse grupper (landbrugsskoler, kommuner, virksomheder, ERFA, ). 

Om dig

  • Du har en stærk faglig baggrund (skov- og landskabsingeniør, agronom, produktionsgartner, jordbrugsteknolog eller lignende).

  • Du trives i et tværfagligt miljø hvor hoved og hænder skal arbejde sammen. Du kan planlægge en beplantning om morgenen og sidde på traktoren eller beskære træer om eftermiddagen. 

  • Du har maskinerfaring og er vant til at side bare rattet i større maskiner. 

  • Ideelt set bor du omkring Kolding, Vejle eller Skanderborg, da det er herfra vi har flest aktiviteter. 

Vi tilbyder

  • En absolut nøglerolle i en af Danmarks mest ambitiøse landbrugsvirksomheder. 

  • Muligheden for at bygge og forme morgendagens landbrugs-infrastruktur fra bunden.

  • Et dynamisk, uformelt miljø, hvor der er kort fra idé til handling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og stor mulighed for at vokse med virksomheden, når vi skalerer mod 500+ hektar skovlandbrug under drift. 

Ansøgning Send dit CV og en kort, mail om, hvorfor du er den rette til at drive vores marker. Vi holder samtaler løbende.

title: Rengøring 30-37 timer
description:
Horsens Rengøring har meget travlt og søger 2 nye medarbejdere til vores Kørende Teams - er du en af dem?Vi er en uhøjtidelig virksomhed, med fokus på humor, samarbejde og ordentlighed og vi løfter sammen.

Vil du med på et af vores Teams så læs videre og skynd dig at sende din ansøgning – vi mangler dig.

HVEM ER DU?Som person er det vigtigt, at du er stabil, pligtopfyldende, positiv af sind og god til at indgå i et team. Vi forventer også at du er effektiv og kvalitetsbevidst i dit arbejde.

JOBBETDu møder ind på vores kontor, hvor du sammen med en kollega kører rundt på forskellige opgaver i firmabil. Det kan være rengøringsopgaver i private hjem, flytte- og håndværkerrengøringer, trappevask, kontorer m.m. I er tilbage på kontoret mellem kl. 14.00-16.00. Du vil få en aktiv og travl dag med gode og spændende opgaver og søde, hjælpsomme kollegaer.

KRAV TIL DEN RETTE KANDIDATDet er et krav, at du har kørekort til manuel gear og taler, læser og forstår dansk eller som minimum engelsk.Straffeattest skal forevises.Erfaring er en fordel, men ikke nødvendig, da du vil få en grundig praktisk oplæring samt en kollega at køre med.

ARBEJDSTID & STEDArbejdstiden er 30-37 timer ugentlig. Du møder på vores adresse Spedalsø 45, Horsens kl. 7.00 mandag til fredag og har fri omkring kl. 15.00-16.00. Der er en vagt hver 6. lørdag.

STARTJobbet er ledigt nu - så du skal kunne begynde meget hurtigt.

LØNVi har overenskomst, så løn og vilkår er ud fra Serviceoverenskomsten.

ANSØGHvis du er interesseret, så udfyld formularen hurtigst muligt på vores hjemmeside www.horsensrengøring.dk under Jobs og vedhæft dit CV.

title: Terminalmedarbejder til aftenhold i Hvidovre - try and hire
description:
På vegne af vores samarbejdspartner søger vi en engageret, kvalitetsbevidst og initiativrig terminalen i Hvidovre. Der er tale om et 3-måneders fuldtidsvikariat med henblik på fastansættelse for den rette kandidat.

Du bliver en del af et try-and-hire-forløb, hvor de første 3 måneder giver både dig og virksomheden mulighed for at se hinanden an med henblik på en permanent ansættelse.

Du bliver en del af en af Skandinaviens største globale transport- og logistikvirksomheder, hvor du indgår i et dynamisk team med 10-15 gode kollegaer. Her er der fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi søger ikke bare en kollega, men også en person, der har lyst til at tage ansvar, byde ind og være en aktiv del af hverdagen. Du må gerne være lidt fremme i skoene, have en udadvendt personlighed og trives med at tage initiativ – både når det gælder arbejdsopgaverne og det sociale fællesskab.

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du sammen med teamet skal være med til at sikre, at driften på terminalen fungerer optimalt. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Aflæsning og læsning af gods

  • Varemodtagelse og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Brug af kørende udstyr

  • Dokumenthåndtering

  • Registrering og håndtering af varer i lagerstyringssystemet

  • Diverse manuelle lageropgaver

Det er vigtigt, at du er indstillet på, at jobbet ikke udelukkende foregår på truck. En del af arbejdsdagen vil også bestå af manuelle og fysisk krævende opgaver, herunder løft og håndtering af gods.

Vi forestiller os, at du er en udadvendt og engageret person, der både fagligt og socialt har lyst til at være en del af et team.

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Har et gyldigt truckcertifikat

  • Er indstillet på både truckkørsel og fysisk krævende, manuelle lageropgaver

  • Trives i et travlt og internationalt miljø

  • Er initiativrig og ikke bange for at tage ansvar

  • Er udadvendt og bidrager aktivt til et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø

  • Har en proaktiv tilgang til arbejdet og gerne byder ind med idéer og løsninger

  • Arbejder struktureret og systematisk og har øje for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Har flair for IT

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ejerskab for dine opgaver, bidrage til fællesskabet og være med til at få hverdagen til at fungere – også når der er travlt.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdstid: Mandag til fredag kl. 12:00-20:00

  • Arbejdstid pr. uge: 37 timer

  • Arbejdssted: Hvidovre

  • Ansættelse: 3 måneders fuldtidsvikariat gennem StudentConsulting med henblik på fastansættelse hos kunden

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

  • Løn: 189 kr./timen

Da du skal arbejde med sikkerhedsgodkendte områder og luftfragtgods, skal du kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes af myndighederne. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan redegøre for din beskæftigelse og/eller aktiviteter i de seneste 6 måneder i dit CV.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen?

Ønsker du at være en del af et energisk arbejdsmiljø, der samtidig har personligheden og engagementet til at tage ansvar, tage initiativ og bidrage positivt til et team, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send dit CV og din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

title: Ledelseskonsulent tæt på topledelsen
description:
Har du blik for den strategiske retning, den gode proces og de konkrete opgaver, der får hverdagen til at hænge sammen? Og motiveres du af at arbejde tæt på en direktion med høje ambitioner for både studerende, medarbejdere og samfundet? Så er du måske vores nye ledelseskonsulent. Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde helt tæt på de beslutninger, der er med til at styrke uddannelser med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Absalon står midt i en historisk reform af professionsuddannelserne og arbejder samtidig med en ambitiøs strategi frem mod 2030, som skal sikre dygtige professionelle til de professioner, vi uddanner til. Som ledelseskonsulent for de to direktører, der har ansvaret for Absalons uddannelser, efter- og videreuddannelser samt forskning, sikrer du sammen med direktionens øvrige ledelseskonsulenter sammenhæng, fremdrift og professionel ledelsesunderstøttelse på tværs af direktionens opgaver og ansvarsområder. Din profil

Du er en erfaren og struktureret generalist, der kan bevæge dig sikkert mellem strategisk udvikling, procesledelse og praktisk koordinering - og kan genkende dig selv i følgende: God organisationsforståelse og stærke samarbejdsevner. Du har erfaring med at agere i en kompleks organisation og er dygtig til at skabe og udvikle relationer. Dine samarbejdskompetencer er veludviklede, og du trives i samarbejdet med både topledelse, øvrig ledelse, medarbejdere i alle funktioner, studerende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Erfaring med ledelsesunderstøttelse og beslutningsgange. Du har erfaring med at understøtte en topledelse og et sikkert blik for, hvad der skaber værdi i en travl hverdag. Alternativt har du erfaring fra en politisk styret organisation og ved, hvad der skal til for at få sager sikkert gennem de relevante processer frem mod en beslutning. Du tager initiativ, når opgaver skal prioriteres, struktureres eller følges til dørs, og du skriver kort, klart og præcist. Erfaring med procesledelse. Du kan skabe fremdrift og håndtere interessenter med forskellige og til tider modsatrettede ønsker og behov. Du planlægger og driver professionelle processer med den rette balance mellem involvering, kvalitet og tempo. Selvstændig og handlekraftig. Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver, skaber selv overblik og fremdrift og følger op uden at skulle sættes i gang. Samtidig er du god til at afstemme retning og involvere andre, når der er behov for det. Nysgerrig på AI. Du ser AI som et værktøj og en sparringspartner i udviklingen af opgaver. Du tør eksperimentere med nye løsninger, deler erfaringer med kolleger og bidrager til at modne vores fælles brug af teknologien, hvor den skaber værdi. Trives med alsidighed. Du trives med at skifte mellem udviklingsopgaver, korte leverancer og de konkrete koordinerende opgaver. Vi forventer, at du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse samt erfaring fra en lignende stilling. Stillingen indplaceres som special- eller chefkonsulent afhængigt af din erfaring og kompetencer. Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver afspejler det, der fylder på de to direktørers bord. Nogle opgaver ligger allerede fast, mens andre vil blive formet med afsæt i din profil og det, du bringer med dig. Ledelsesunderstøttelse og beslutningsgrundlag. Du udarbejder oplæg og beslutningsgrundlag til blandt andet direktion og bestyrelse. Du understøtter de to direktører med procesplaner, præsentationer, mødeforberedelse, sparring, planlægning og koordinering, og du er med til at sikre, at relevante processer igangsættes og følges op. Nogle opgaver opstår med kort varsel og kræver, at du hurtigt kan gribe dem og levere. Andre kræver, at du holder fast over tid, skaber fremdrift og følger processen helt til dørs. Et stærkt og samarbejdende chefteam. Du understøtter og deltager i de faste møder i de to direktørers fælles centerchefteam, som består af seks chefer og de to direktører. Du planlægger, forbereder og følger op på møderne og bidrager både med struktur, koordinering og udvikling af chefteamets samarbejde og arbejdsform. Sektorsamarbejde. Begge direktører er involveret i sektorsamarbejde på tværs af de seks professionshøjskoler inden for deres ansvarsområde, fx inden for forsknings- eller sundhedsområdet. Du bidrager til at forberede og følge op på møder og konferencer i tæt samarbejde med direktøren og kolleger på de øvrige professionshøjskoler. Tværgående opgaver. Du får enkelte tværgående opgaver på tværs af hele organisationen. Det kan fx være de halvårlige seminarer for alle Absalons ledere, der planlægges i tæt samarbejde med kolleger og den ansvarlige direktør. Dine kolleger

Du bliver ansat i Kommunikation og Ledelsessekretariat, hvor vi arbejder for at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for, at Absalon lykkes med strategien om at uddanne dygtige professionelle og realiserer ambitionerne i uddannelsesreformen. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger fordelt på tre teams. Du bliver en del af Team Ledelsesunderstøttelse, som understøtter direktionen og Absalons fem centerchefer. Vi har hver især et tæt samarbejde med den eller de ledere, vi understøtter i hverdagen, samtidig med at vi som team løbende koordinerer og sparrer om fælles opgaver og indsatser. Vi bliver sammen opdateret på strategiske initiativer, nye processer og øvrige udviklinger, der har betydning for vores arbejde, så vi kan sikre sammenhæng og understøtte organisationen bedst muligt. Hos os møder du en organisation, der både er ambitiøs og uhøjtidelig. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet og gode rammer for balance mellem arbejds- og privatliv. Dit primære ansættelsessted vil være enten på vores campus i Roskilde eller i Slagelse. Hver fredag samles afdelingen på Campus Slagelse, hvor vi har afdelingsmøder, teammøder mv. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde 1-2 dage om ugen. Sådan ansøger du

  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og med ansættelses hurtigst muligt og senest den 1. februar 2027.
  • Stillingen indplaceres som special - eller chefkonsulent med en forventet løn på mellem 56.486 kr. og 60.800 kr. pr. måned inkl. pension.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte sekretariatschef, Nanna Ferslev, på telefon 7248 1260 eller naf@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 6. december 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler den 11. december og 2. samtaler den 16. december 2026.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Absalon

Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

title: Kirketjener søges til Treenighedskirken i Esbjerg
description:
Har du hænderne skruet godt på og hjertet på rette sted? Kan du lide at møde mennesker, skabe gode rammer og få praktiske ting til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye kirketjener i Treenighedskirken. Vi søger en engageret, ansvarsbevidst og imødekommende kollega, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores kirke og fællesskab. Vi er et engageret team bestående af tre præster, to organister, en kirkesanger, en kordegn/daglig leder og en kirketjener/kirke- og kulturmedarbejder, som du vil få et tæt samarbejde med om fordelingen af vagter og praktiske opgaver. Treenighedskirken er en levende kirke med mange forskellige aktiviteter. Her mødes mennesker i alle aldre til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, koncerter, foredrag og sociale arrangementer. Som kirketjener er du en af de første, vores kirkegængere og besøgende møder. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på, at du er et varmt og rummeligt menneske, der møder andre med venlighed, nærvær og respekt. Du skal kunne skabe en tryg og imødekommende atmosfære, uanset om du tager imod gæster til en festlig begivenhed eller møder mennesker i en svær livssituation. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Er venlig, omsorgsfuld og god til at møde mennesker i alle livets situationer.
  • Har et naturligt værtskab og sætter en ære i at give kirkens besøgende en god oplevelse.
  • Er selvstændig, ansvarsbevidst og god til at planlægge din arbejdsdag.
  • Har praktisk sans, ordenssans og gerne hænderne skruet godt på.
  • Trives med både faste rutiner og dage, hvor planerne ændrer sig.
  • Er fleksibel, hjælpsom og god til at samarbejde med kolleger, præster, menighedsråd og frivillige.
  • Har øje for detaljerne og tager ansvar for, at kirken og dens omgivelser fremstår pæne og indbydende.
Du behøver ikke at være uddannet kirketjener på forhånd. Hvis du ikke har gennemført den obligatoriske femugers kirketjeneruddannelse, skal den gennemføres inden for de første to år af ansættelsen. Stillingen er primært en kirketjenerstilling, som udgør 80 % af arbejdstiden, mens de resterende 20 % er afsat til opgaver som kirke- og kulturmedarbejder. Dine arbejdsopgaver Som kirketjener er du med til at skabe gode rammer om kirkens liv og aktiviteter. Arbejdsdagene er alsidige og byder på både praktiske opgaver og kontakt med mange forskellige mennesker. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:
  • Klargøring af kirken til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer.
  • At tage godt imod kirkegængere og besøgende og være en imødekommende vært.
  • Praktisk medvirken ved gudstjenester, dåb, vielser, bisættelser og begravelser.
  • At deltage i udvalgsarbejde.
  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirken og dens øvrige lokaler.
  • Indkøb og andre praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med kirkens daglige drift, herunder lettere køkkenarbejde.
  • Vedligeholdelse af kirkens udendørsarealer.
  • Snerydning foran kirkens indgange samt saltning og glatførebekæmpelse efter behov.
  • Rekvirering og koordinering af håndværkere i samarbejde med kirkeværgen.
Du bliver en vigtig del af det daglige samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sammen sørger for, at kirken er et rart sted at komme – både for menigheden, besøgende og medarbejdere. Et job med variation og fællesskab Arbejdet følger kirkens rytme, og ingen uger er helt ens. Nogle dage er præget af praktiske opgaver og forberedelser, mens andre byder på gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer med mange mennesker. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med fast fridag om mandagen og fri hver anden weekend. Arbejdstiden omfatter både dag- og aftentimer samt arbejde på helligdage. De to kirketjenere afløser hinanden ved ferie og andet fravær. Vi lægger vægt på et godt kollegialt samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udviser fleksibilitet og tager fælles ansvar for kirkens daglige liv. Vi tilbyder
  • En alsidig og meningsfuld arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver.
  • Et arbejde med stor menneskelig kontakt, hvor du gør en forskel for andre.
  • Et godt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede kolleger.
  • Mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar og indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af dine opgaver.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor både menneskelige og praktiske kompetencer bliver værdsat.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Er du nysgerrig på løn- og ansættelsesvilkår – så klik her. Har du lyst til at blive vores nye kollega? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Fortæl os lidt om dig selv, dine erfaringer, og hvorfor du har lyst til at arbejde som kirketjener hos os. Vi er mindst lige så interesserede i mennesket bag CV'et som i dine formelle kvalifikationer. Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt eller senest den 1. februar 2027. Ansøgningsfrist: den 28. november 2026, kl. 12.00 Tiltrædelse: den 1. februar 2027 eller før Ansøgning sendes til: 8907fortrolig@sogn.dk Ansættelsessamtaler forventes afholdt den 10. december. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte menighedsrådsformand, Peter Hundebøll på tlf. 2944 3999. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og forhåbentlig byde dig velkommen som en del af fællesskabet i Treenighedskirken.

title: Driftsleder/Supervisor til produktionen i Birkerød
description:
Der søges på vegne af vores samarbjedspartner i Birkerød (ENGLISH VERSION BELOW)

Vi er en dansk scale-up i Nordsjælland, der udvikler, producerer og sælger hampbaserede produkter. Vi arbejder med hele processen fra råvare til færdigt produkt og står overfor at udvide med egne produktionsfaciliteter, så vi kan lancere nye produktkategorier og skalere produktionen.Hverdagen er præget af høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed, dokumentation og stabile processer.

Om rollen

Vi søger en supervisor, der kan få den daglige drift i produktionen til at hænge sammen. Du skal skabe overblik på gulvet, følge op på opgaverne og være med til at sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal.

Det er en hands-on rolle, hvor du både deltager i arbejdet og har ansvar for den daglige koordinering i produktionen. Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet under Operationschefen og får en central rolle i at holde flow, kvalitet og fremdrift i hverdagen.

Personaleansvar er ikke et krav, men du skal have erfaring med arbejdsledelse eller daglig supervision i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Sikre den daglige koordinering og arbejdsfordeling i produktionen

  • Følge op på, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og til tiden

  • Holde overblik over flowet på linjerne og reagere hurtigt ved stop, afvigelser eller flaskehalse

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen, herunder betjening og overvågning af produktions- og fillingsprocedurer

  • Sikre hygiejne, sporbarhed og dokumentation på batch-niveau

  • Udføre og følge op på in-process-kontroller samt sikre, at kvalitetsdata er opdateret i de digitale systemer

  • Bidrage til orden, rengøring, first-level vedligehold på linjerne

  • Samarbejde tæt med lager og logistik om råvareflow og færdigvareafhentning

  • Være med til at forbedre arbejdsgange og skabe mere struktur i takt med, at produktionen udvikler sig

Din profil

  • Du har erfaring fra fødevare-, kosmetik-, pharma- eller anden procesindustri

  • Du har erfaring med arbejdsledelse, koordinering eller daglig supervision i en produktion

  • Du er vant til at arbejde struktureret og holde overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, renlighed og det at følge procedurer

  • Du kan læse og skrive dansk og/eller engelsk

  • Du er tryg ved at arbejde i digitale systemer og kan lære nye processer og værktøjer

  • Du tager ansvar, når noget skal løses, og bidrager naturligt til, at hverdagen fungerer

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i den daglige drift af produktionen

  • Fast daghold med mulighed for fleks efter aftale

  • Grundig oplæring, inkl. træning i vores principper

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn samt frokostordning, pensionsordning og arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for at vokse i takt med, at vi skalerer nye linjer og automatiserer processer

Ansøgning

Send CV og kort motiveret ansøgning til job@chc.dk snarest og senest d. 27. november 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Har du spørgsmål, så ring til 71 99 19 55 eller skriv til km@chc.dk.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

______________________________________________________________

Production Supervisor – Hands-on Role

Location: Birkerød, North Zealand, Denmark

Recruitment on behalf of our partner company in Birkerød.

We are a Danish scale-up based in North Zealand, developing, manufacturing and selling hemp-based products. We manage the entire process, from raw materials to finished products, and are preparing to expand our operations with our own production facilities. This will allow us to introduce new product categories and increase production capacity.

Our daily operations require high standards of quality, traceability, documentation and process consistency.

About the Role

We are looking for a Production Supervisor who can help keep our daily production operations running smoothly. You will coordinate work on the production floor, follow up on tasks and help ensure that production runs efficiently and according to plan.

This is a hands-on position, combining active participation in production with responsibility for day-to-day coordination and supervision.

You will work as part of the team reporting to the Head of Operations and play an important role in maintaining production flow, quality and progress.

Formal line management or personnel responsibility is not required, but you must have experience supervising, coordinating or leading daily work in a manufacturing environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily production activities and allocate tasks across the production team.

  • Follow up to ensure tasks are completed correctly and on schedule.

  • Monitor production flow and respond quickly to interruptions, deviations and bottlenecks.

  • Participate directly in production, including operating and monitoring production equipment and filling processes.

  • Ensure hygiene, traceability and batch-level documentation.

  • Perform and follow up on in-process quality checks, ensuring that quality data is accurately recorded in our digital systems.

  • Maintain good housekeeping, cleaning routines and first-level equipment maintenance on the production floor.

  • Work closely with warehouse and logistics colleagues to coordinate raw material supply and the movement of finished goods.

  • Help improve workflows and establish more structured processes as production expands.

Your Profile

  • You have experience in food manufacturing, cosmetics, supplements, pharmaceuticals or another process-based manufacturing industry.

  • You have previous experience with production-floor supervision, work coordination or day-to-day production leadership.

  • You work in a structured manner and can maintain an overview in a busy production environment.

  • You understand the importance of quality, cleanliness and following established procedures.

  • You can read and write in Danish and/or English.

  • You are comfortable using digital systems and willing to learn new processes and tools.

  • You take responsibility, solve problems when they arise and actively contribute to keeping daily operations running smoothly.

What We Offer

  • An important role in the daily operation and development of our production facilities.

  • Fixed daytime working hours, with flexibility by agreement.

  • Thorough onboarding and training, including training in our operational principles and procedures.

  • Competitive salary, a company lunch scheme, an employer pension scheme and employer-paid private health insurance.

  • Opportunities to develop professionally as we expand production lines and introduce further automation.

How to Apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to job@chc.dk as soon as possible and no later than the 27th of November 2026.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please call +45 71 99 19 55 or email km@chc.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication• Networks• Antennas• Control systems• Sound• Artifical intelligence• Signal Processing• Computing• Quantum technology • Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.• participating in grant application activities• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirementsApplicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

title: Academic Coordinator for the EUROfusion Project
description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI) at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for one funded Academic Staff position, to be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. The temporary position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter, until 31 December 2027. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Work environment

The candidate will be part of SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development, and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently about 24 researchers, engineers and PhD students, specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

Job description

The candidate will be project administrator for the EUROfusion project. Jointly, and together with the rest of the team around this project, this goes for other institutes and departments of SDU TEK together with partners from ITER and EUROfusion. 

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have the following qualifications:

  • Good communication and collaborative skills

  • Good English and Danish skills, both written and spoken

  • Can work independently and have a good overview

  • IT skills and being good at developing and maintaining procedures

  • Background in engineering will be useful, e.g. involving handling of 3D models

Contact information

For further information, please contact Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: November 30, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Hotel Allrounder (Bar, F&B, Reception all in one role)
description:
Hospitality job in Copenhagen. One role, many hats. No two days alike.  Love good coffee, great drinks and even better conversation? Want a hotel job where no day feels the same? Keep reading.   Most hotel jobs put you in one spot. At Zoku, you’ll be everywhere that matters. 

From welcoming guests and sharing local tips to serving great food, making coffee, and mixing cocktails, you’ll help create the experience people remember long after they’ve checked out. If variety is your thing and making people feel genuinely at home comes naturally to you, you might be exactly who we’re looking for. 

At Zoku, we’re not your typical hotel. We’re a community-driven space where people can live, work, socialize, and connect with the city around them. We believe hospitality should feel personal, human, and effortless and that starts with the people on our team. That’s where you come in! 

WHAT IS A SIDEKICK?  

At Zoku, we call our hospitality all-rounders “Sidekicks”. You can think of this role as a Guest Experience Host: someone who combines reception, restaurant, bar, and guest services into one dynamic hospitality role. You’re the friendly face welcoming guests at check in, the person recommending your favorite local spots, the bartender making someone’s evening, and the host creating a warm atmosphere in our rooftop Living Kitchen restaurant. 

No two days are the same and that’s exactly why people love this role. 

WHAT YOU’LL ACTUALLY DO 

Behind the bar. Pull espressos in the morning, pour craft beer in the afternoon, shake cocktails at night. We'll teach you the recipes, you bring the chat. 

In the restaurant. Serve breakfast, lunch, dinner and bites in our Living Kitchen and on our rooftop terraces with great views over the city. Guide guests to the right wine, the right small plate, the right table. 

At the front desk. Welcome arriving guests, handle check-ins & check-outs, and answer the inevitable "where's the best bakery in Copenhagen?" with the kind of tips only a local would know. 

YOUR SCHEDULE 

You’ll work independently across different departments, with both morning and afternoon/evening shifts. A standard shift is 8 hours with a 30 minute meal break. Your responsibilities and hours may vary.

  • Morning Shift (AM Shift): 07:00 to 15:00 (+/- 1 hour)

  • Afternoon/Evening Shift (PM Shift): 15:00 to 23:00 (+/- 1 hour)

YOU’LL FIT RIGHT IN IF YOU 

  • Are genuinely friendly, and open. 

  • Love creating unforgettable stays where guests feel a true sense of belonging. 

  • Thrive in social, energetic environments. 

  • Like variety and can easily switch between different tasks. 

  • Are proactive, hands on, and team oriented. 

  • Have a genuine interest in hospitality, food, drinks, travel, or community. 

  • Love discovering and sharing the best spots in Copenhagen. 

 

A FEW MUST HAVES 

  • You have worked in hospitality or in a similar customer-facing industry.

  • You are fluent in English - Danish and any other languages are a big plus!

  • You are an EU resident or have a valid working and living permit to work in Denmark.

  • You have a CPR-number / tax number and a Danish bank account.

  • You are flexible, as there are no fixed working days / hours and enjoy working both week days and weekends.

  • You are available to work either 32 hours weekly (4 shifts) or 37 hours weekly (Full Time-5 Shifts).

 

Start date: We’re ready to welcome our next Sidekick as soon as possible! We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis, so don’t snooze, apply today! We’re all about finding the right match for our amazing team.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • We’ll screen applications as they are submitted.

  • We’ll give you a call to for a quick get to know each other chat.

  • We’ll invite you in for either 1 or 2 interviews to get a tour of Zoku and meet the Team.

  • We’ll finalize the offer and get you started!

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU 

You’ll join an international team filled with people who genuinely care about hospitality, creativity, and community. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey! 

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • A 40% discount on food & drinks for you and up to 4 friends 

  • Discounted Employee- and Friends & Family rates across all Zoku locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Vienna and Paris) 

  • The best staff meals, enjoyed in our rooftop Social Spaces overlooking the city. 

  • A free night stay for you and a +1 in your first 3 months – plus another free night at any Zoku location for your birthday celebration 

  • Access to all community events, team celebrations, and after work drinks 

  • Exciting on-the-job training opportunities and fun events throughout the year to celebrate achievements and milestones.

  • A personal budget after your first year: spend it on extra days off, learning, or take it as cash  

Check out all benefits here.  

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Zoku combines the energy of a lifestyle brand with the warmth of a close knit team. We challenge traditional hospitality by creating spaces where people genuinely connect, whether they’re staying for one night or several months. 

Next to our award-winning design and our global press fan club, we’re proud to be a certified B Corp across all our locations, meaning we care deeply about people, community, and doing business with a heart (not just as a marketing line). 

WHAT THE ZOKU?!  We’re Zoku. Designed for the new generation of business travelers, we’re so much more than a long stay hotel. We’re a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. We’ve created a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so you can stay connected and well rested as you live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities. It will be your home city next.  READY? Hit apply and tell us why this role has your name on it.

title: Familierådgivningen i Ikast-Brande Kommune søger en nærværende og engageret timeaflaster til en skøn dreng på 4 år med autisme.
description:
Er du glad for leg, sang, fjollerier og hyggelige stunder? Og har du samtidig roen og tålmodigheden til at møde et barn med særlige behov? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Formålet med timeaflastning er at aflaste forældrene til et barn med nedsat fysisk- eller psykisk funktionsevne og give dem et pusterum. Udgangspunktet er altid samvær med barnet. Det kan være at passe barnet i hjemmet, lave aktiviteter eller at tage barnet med på små ture ud af hjemmet, typisk mens forældrene ikke er til stede i hjemmet.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er fyldt 18 år og kan fremvise ren straffe- og børneattest.
  • Er omsorgsfuld, nærværende og har lyst til at skabe en god relation til Theo.
  • Er tålmodig og kan bevare roen, også når situationer bliver udfordrende.
  • Har forståelse for betydningen af struktur og forudsigelighed.
  • Er opmærksom på kropssprog og nonverbal kommunikation.
  • Har interesse for at arbejde med børn med særlige behov. Erfaring med autisme er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
  • Kan komme til og fra familiens hjem i Ikast, eventuelt i egen bil.

 

Du skal ikke kunne det hele på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du møder Theo med varme, nysgerrighed og forståelse – og har lyst til at lære ham at kende.

Stillingen er på op til 47,66 timer pr. måned og timerne vil være placeret enten på hverdage i løbet af ugen fra sidst på eftermiddagen eller i weekenderne. Jobbet som timeaflaster er ofte en sidebeskæftigelse, et fritids- eller studiejob.Det kan også være et fleksjob.

At være timeaflaster er en fantastisk mulighed for at hjælpe og gøre noget godt for andre.Mød Theo 

Theo er en dejlig dreng på 4 år, som elsker at fjolle, synge, lægge puslespil, bygge forhindringsbaner og tumle. Han holder af både aktive lege og hyggelige stunder, hvor der er plads til nærvær og sjov.

Theo har autisme og oplever verden på sin egen måde. Han bruger ikke talesprog, men kommunikerer gennem sit kropssprog, sine ansigtsudtryk og sine handlinger. Som aflaster får du mulighed for at lære hans signaler at kende og opbygge en god og tryg relation til ham.

Theo trives allerbedst med faste rutiner og genkendelige rammer. Når han ved, hvad der skal ske, giver det ham tryghed og overskud til at nyde dagens aktiviteter. Derfor har han brug for en voksen, der kan skabe struktur og forudsigelighed og møde ham i hans eget tempo.

Som alle andre børn kan Theo opleve situationer, hvor følelserne bliver store. Her har han brug for en rolig og tålmodig voksen, som kan hjælpe ham med at finde tilbage til trygheden – også når noget bliver svært.

I løbet af dagen har Theo brug for små pauser, hvor han blandt andet nyder at se musikvideoer eller spille små spil på sin tablet. Det hjælper ham med at finde ro og samle ny energi.

 

Hvad indebærer opgaven?

Som timeaflaster bliver din vigtigste opgave at skabe gode og meningsfulde oplevelser sammen med Theo og samtidig give hans forældre mulighed for aflastning i hverdagen.

Opgaven vil primært foregå i familiens hjem, hvor der også kan være andre familiemedlemmer og/eller en anden aflaster til stede i forbindelse med familiens øvrige børn.

Jeres tid sammen kan eksempelvis bestå af leg, sang, puslespil, bevægelsesaktiviteter og hyggelige stunder med udgangspunkt i Theos interesser og dagsform.

Du skal desuden kunne støtte Theo i de praktiske og personlige behov, han har i løbet af dagen.

Ansættelsesproces

Du ansøger om jobbet som timeaflaster via selvbetjeningsløsning nedenfor. Hvis dine kvalifikationer er relevante, kontakter familien dig for en samtale, så i sammen finder ud af om I er et ”match”. Efter evt. ansættelse, er det dig og familien, der aftaler din arbejdstid og aktiviteter. 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår

Du bliver ansat af Ikast-Brande kommune, hvor du aflønnes ud fra det konkrete forbrug af timer, som du løbende indberetter.

Lønnen er på 161,94 kr. pr. time. Tillæg for arbejde efter kl. 17 på hverdage samt i weekender. Der udbetales desuden feriepenge. 

Der indhentes børne- og straffeattest på dig i forbindelse med ansættelse. 

Hvis du har brug for yderligere oplysninger:

I forhold til selve arbejdet i familiens hjem, kan du kontakte forældrene på telefonnummer 23 38 84 32. I forhold til ansættelsesvilkår, kan du kontakte fagspecialist Heidi Lilholt Holm på mail: helil@ikast-brande.dk - tlf. 99605533.

Lovgivningen

Timeaflastning til børn gives efter barnets lov § 90 stk. 1, nr. 2, jf. servicelovens § 84 stk. 1.

Ansøgningsfrist

Hurtigst muligt!Der holdes løbende ansættelsessamtaler, som vil foregå i hjemmet hos forældrene efter aftale.

title: Associate professor in Artificial Intelligence for Medical Applications at SDU Robotics
description:
To support our advancements in deep learning and AI methods for medical image and clinical data analysis SDU Robotics invites applications for one or more associate professor position(s). The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

 

Job descriptionThe successful candidates will contribute to the unit’s current and future research projects and teaching activities. Key responsibilities include, for example to:

  • Be able to collaborate with our experts and colleagues from SDU Robotics in the further development of our core technologies. 

  • Be deeply involved in our regular coordination and joint evolvement of research and project activities. 

  • Raise funding and manage research projects. 

  • Design and conduct lab experiments. 

  • Participate in the practicalities of actual industrial applications. 

  • Organize, plan and conduct excellent teaching for undergraduate and graduate courses. 

  • Independently supervise project courses, and BSc, MSc and PhD thesis projects. 

The position as an associate professor involves primary responsibilities related to research (including the obligation to publish and disseminate scientific knowledge) and research-based teaching (including examination duties) – research and teaching obligations equally. Additionally, the role may encompass knowledge exchange with society, including participation in public debates. Furthermore, it may entail responsibilities such as research management, curriculum development, guidance, supervision, and scholarly assessment. The university determines the specific allocation of tasks, and the emphasis on these tasks may vary over time.

 

Profile and requirementsThe candidates will participate in SDU Robotics' comprehensive research, and the position requires research experience within artificial intelligence and deep learning for medical applications. This includes documented knowledge within some of the following technologies/areas:

  • Deep learning-based classification, segmentation and detection in 2D and 3D medical images.

  • Machine learning methods for analysis of clinical data.

  • Explainable and interpretable AI methods for medical decision support.

The candidates must have a relevant PhD degree (e.g. in computer science, engineering or a related field) and are expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

  • Experience in acquiring and coordinating publicly and/or privately funded projects.

  • Strong track record of directly engaging with clinical or industrial partners in application-oriented projects and/or a relevant international network for research and collaboration activities.

  • Experience with teaching and independently supervising project courses, and BSc and MSc thesis projects.

  • Experience in teaching AI courses for medical image analysis.

Preferably, the candidates have experience with:

  • Medical image analysis

  • Analysis of clinical and healthcare data

  • Explainable AI

  • Experimental design and validation of AI-based systems

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team. 

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have high self-motivation to learn. 

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Have excellent communication skills in English speaking and writing. 

In the assessment of candidates, consideration will be given to: 

  • Research demonstrated by publications in relevant scientific journals and conferences.

  • Experience in interdisciplinary research collaboration.

  • Teaching experience.

  • A relevant international network for research and collaboration activities, research experience abroad.

  • Experience in attracting funding for research projects and demonstrated experience in research leadership.

 

Research environment The candidate will be integrated into the unit SDU Robotics, which is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We are a team of currently appr. 60 researchers and engineers specialized in research and development of robot solutions and advanced robot systems within the medical, welfare and industrial domain. 

We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. 

The aim of the group is to solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We participate in implementing the results achieved in real solutions with end users like national hospitals, LEGO, Novo Nordisk and Universal Robots.

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

Further informationFurther information about this position is available via email from professor Thiusius R. Savarimuthu trs@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

Get a glimpse of (work)life through the eyes of some of our many excellent researchers at SDU in Odense. 

 

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information. 

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

 

The application deadline is January 11, 2027, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and an application must include: 

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae including personal contact information.

  • Research statement with ideas for research and development activities (max. 4 pages).

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates/diplomas (copy of original and in official English translation).

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant for the position. 

  • Reference and a statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration no.) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: 

Motivated application shall be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents shall be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files of max 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process 

Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Employment as an associate professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor. Employment as associate professor is a permanent position. 

The starting date is in March 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter and will be agreed with the successful candidates. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

title: Flight Instructor - sponsored CRI/SPA program - (Re)location DK, Aarhus
description:

This role offers a unique opportunity to combine flight instruction with classroom-based theory teaching, creating a varied and rewarding workday where your expertise truly makes a difference. The position is full time at our flying base in Aarhus Airport.

You can, as a flight instructor, expect to conduct teaching primarily in flying aboard the aircraft. Occasionally there will also be teaching in the classroom or in the simulator.

When you start at Greybird as a student you have high expectations of the quality of the education. Those are expectations that you, as a flight instructor, will help fulfill. This is both an exciting and challenging task.

  • technical and academic knowledge

  • The ability to work structured and high level of quality awareness

  • Experience in working with people

  • The will to educate in a constructive and professional way

  • A cooperative and welcoming attitude

  • Basic knowledge in IT

Further more we offer:

  • Set monthly pay according to qualification & seniority, pension and private healthcare.

  • Predictable schedule

  • Permanent base in Aarhus Airport

  • Possibility to fly in most of Europe

  • Individual and extensive introduction training

Are you dedicated to training and developing the next generation of pilots? Do you want a varied and rewarding workday where your expertise truly makes a difference? If so, we look forward to hearing from you. All we need is your CV.

By receivement of your CV we will invite you to a confidential, exploratory conversation, where you can share your skills and ambitions, and we can present the opportunities at Greybird.

About Greybird:
