title: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks    The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group  at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

title: Product Owner - Shape the Future of Industrial Ice Cream Filling
description:

You will maintain the product roadmap, prioritize improvements and support projects throughout the value chain—from quotation and technical clarification to production, commissioning and lifecycle support.

title: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

  • compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

  • formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

  • experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

  • technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

  • approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

  • Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

  • Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

  • Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

  • Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

  • Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

  • Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

  • Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

  • Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

  • Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

  • Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

  • Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

  • A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

  • A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

  • The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

  • A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

  • The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

  • Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

  • Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

  • Translational or application-oriented research.

  • Interdisciplinary collaboration.

  • Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

  • Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

  • Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

  • Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

  • Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

  • The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

  • Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

  • Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

  • Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

  • Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

title: Teamspective: Account Executive (Denmark or Sweden)

title: Gårdtrækker, 34 timer / Yard driver, 34 hours per week
description:
Vi søger lige nu en Gårdtrækker til REMA Distribution A/S på Hjulmagervej 12 i Vejle

Som medarbejder hos REMA Distribution bliver du del af en virksomhed, der vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Du får en central rolle i denne proces og bliver en del af vores gårdtrækkerteam fuld af dygtige og kompetente kolleger i Vejle.

Om jobbetMed reference til Driftschefen indgår du i vores team af medarbejdere, som arbejder tæt sammen med vores lager og logistikafdeling.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver:

  • Kørsel med Gårdtrækker på terminalområdet

  • Til- og frakobling af trailere

  • Klargøring til læsning og losning

  • Truckkørsel og intern transport

  • Læsning, losning og håndtering af gods

  • Lager- og terminalopgaver efter behov

  • Rengøring af Terberg.

Vores lager sørger for, at traileren er læsset og klar, inden den skal fjernes. Du får et selvstændigt og udfordrende fuldtidsjob med løn iflg. overenskomst, pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

Du vil skulle arbejde i et 3-ugers rul. Arbejdstiden er om eftermiddagen og skifter i tidsrummet ml. kl. 10.00 og kl. 23.00. Der må påregnes overarbejde i travle perioder.

Dine faglige kvalifikationer

  • Du har kørekort til C/E, chaufføruddannelsesbevis, førerkort og truckcertifikat

  • Du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

  • Du taler og skriver dansk og/eller engelsk

Dine personlige kvalifikationer

Du er som person selvstændig, serviceminded og sætter en ære i at gøre tingene ordentligt. Som medarbejder og kollega er du fleksibel på arbejdstiden, mødestabil og imødekommende. Du arbejder effektivt uden at miste fokus på sikkerheden, og du har lyst til at give vores kunder en god oplevelse, hvor end du kommer.

Om REMA 1000

I REMA 1000 er vi mere end 17.500 entusiastiske mennesker med ét fælles mål: Vi vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Det absolut vigtigste element i den mission er engagerede og virkelystne mennesker, som elsker at gøre en forskel i deres job.

Vi har i dag flere end 440 butikker, og butikkerne er drevet efter en franchisemodel med selvstændige, lokalkendte købmænd i spidsen for den enkelte butik.

I Baglandet hos REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution er vi mere end 1.300 medarbejdere, som skaber konkurrencekraft, servicerer og leverer varer til REMA 1000 butikkerne og andre kæder indenfor dagligvare- og convenience branchen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?Så send os en ansøgning til Drifschef Brian Schmidt på mail: bsc@rema1000.dk .

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen vil derfor blive fjernet når passende kandidat er fundet.

ENGLISH:

We are currently looking for a Yard Driver to join REMA Distribution A/S, Hjulmagervej 12, Vejle in Denmark.

As an employee at REMA Distribution, you will become part of a company that aims to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices. You will play an important role in this process and become part of our yard shunter team in Vejle, working alongside skilled and competent colleagues.

About the job

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be part of a team working closely with our warehouse and logistics department.

Responsibilities

·       Your duties will include:

·       Operating a yard driver within the terminal area.

·       Connect and Disconnect trailers.

·       Preparing trailers for loading and unloading.

·       Operating forklifts and carrying out internal transport.

·       Loading, unloading and handling goods.

·       Performing warehouse and terminal duties as required.

·       Cleaning of Terberg.

Our warehouse team ensures that trailers are loaded and ready before they need to be moved.

You will have an independent and challenging full-time position with pay in accordance with the applicable collective agreement, as well as a pension scheme and health insurance.

You will work on a 3-week rotating schedule. Your working hours will vary between 10:00 and 23:00. Overtime should be expected during busy periods.

Your professional qualifications

  • You hold a valid Category C/E driving licence, Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC), driver card and forklift licence

  • You have experience from a similar position

  • You are able to speak and write Danish and/or English

Your personal qualities

You are independent, service-minded and take pride in doing your job properly.

As an employee and colleague, you are flexible regarding working hours, reliable and approachable. You work efficiently without compromising safety, and you are motivated to provide our customers with a positive experience wherever your work takes you.

About REMA 1000

At REMA 1000, we are more than 17,500 enthusiastic employees working towards one common goal: to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices.

The most important element in achieving this mission is having dedicated and motivated people who are passionate about making a difference in their work.

Today, we have more than 435 stores, operated according to a franchise model, with independent local franchisees responsible for each individual store.

At REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution's support organisation, we have more than 1,300 employees who help strengthen our competitiveness, provide services and deliver goods to REMA 1000 stores and other chains within the grocery and convenience sector.

Does this sound like the job for you?

Please send your application to Operations Manager Brian Schmidt by email at bsc@rema1000.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the job advertisement will therefore be removed once a suitable candidate has been found.

title: Anesthesia nurse are sought for Anesthesia Department 2
description: We are looking for anesthesia nurses who wish to work in a department that provides anesthesia for cardiac, pulmonary, vascular, and gastrointestinal surgery patients. During on-call shifts, we are responsible for the same clinical specialties as during daytime hours, but we also work as part of a broad cross-team on-call group. We support one another to ensure that the overall anesthesia workload in the operating suite runs smoothly for the benefit of patients. In addition, we currently have one abdominal surgery operating list per week at Aalborg Hospital South on Hobrovej.If you are passionate about anesthesia, professional excellence, and meaningful patient journeys, we look forward to hearing from you. Questions?For any questions regarding the position please contact Head Nurse Manager Merete Isaksen Dietz by phone on +45 30 56 75 32 or by e-mail at mli@rn.dk.For any questions regarding Danish authorization or the process hereof and language requirements, please contact HR Consultant Michelle Cederstrøm - m.cederstroem@rn.dk Practical informationSalary and terms of employment are in accordance with the applicable collective agreement for non-managerial staff within the Danish Health Confederation's area, concluded with the Danish Nurses' Organization. Selleks tuleb igapäevaselt kliendiga koos või tema jaoks teha erinevaid tegevusi: - iseseisvalt elamiseks vajalike oskuste õpetamine; - tööalane nõustamine; - vajadusel arsti külastamine; - juhendamine kodu korrashoiul ja toitumisel; - suhtlemine kliendi lähedastega; - dokumentide haldamine; - vaba aja sisustamise motiveerimine või juhendamine; - võrgustiku- ja meeskonnatöö korraldamine. Kliendiga tehtud töö tuleb dokumenteerida ning see võtab umbes pool tööajast. Töö nõuab tahtmist ja võimekust ringi liikuda - korterite külastused, arstil, tööandja juures käimised jms. Teenusel olevatele inimestele väljasõitude ja ühisürituste korraldamine ja nendel osalemine. Tööle asudes tuleb arvestada, et osa väljaõppest toimub Tartus.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meil on hooliv ja kokkuhoidev kollektiiv - jagame ühiselt nii muresid kui rõõme. Elvas on kokkuhoidev kollektiiv. Kord kuus toimuvad asutuse töökoosolekud Tartus. Uutele töötajatele toimuvad uue töötaja koolitused, kus kõik erialaga seotud teemad detailselt läbi käime. Lisaks on olemas mentori ja kvaliteedijuhi tugi. Võid kindel olla, et see ametikoht arendab Sind. Töö pakub võimalust tunda end vajaliku ja olulisena. Tööalaste väljakutsetega toimetulekuks toimuvad regulaarsed kovisioonid ja supervisioonid. Pakume puhkust suveperioodil ja tasustatud lisapuhkepäevi jõulude ajal ning tasustatud vaba päeva võimalust. Toimuvad ühised väljasõidud õppimise- ja kogemuste saamise eesmärgil. Sul on töö tegemiseks oma kindel töökoht, arvuti ja töö telefoniga. Juhul kui erialane haridus puudub, on võimalik see omandada tööl käimise ajal.

Muud nõuded: Töö edukaks elluviimiseks on vaja järgmisi omadusi: hoolivus, sallivus, vastutustunne, asjatundlikkus, avatus, uuendusmeelsus. Sul peab olema valmisolek tööks puuetega inimestega - võimekus toime tulla pingelistes olukordades, kus on vaja rahu säilitada. Väga oluline on iseenda tundmine, võimekus hoida oma vaimset tervist korras. Samuti on vaja osata oma tööd ja tööaega planeerida. Töö eeldab võimekust töötada nii individuaalselt kui meeskonnas. Parimad tulemused tulevad oskusest ja julgusest küsimusi küsida. Kasuks tuleb hea huumorimeel.

description:
Koduhooldustöötaja

Tööülesanded: Aita inimestel elada väärikalt oma kodus!Estkeer otsib oma Tallinna meeskonda hoolivat, usaldusväärset ja vastutustundlikku koduhooldustöötajat. Meie töö eesmärk on toetada eakaid ja abivajavaid inimesi nende igapäevastes tegevustes, et nad saaksid võimalikult kaua, turvaliselt ja väärikalt oma kodus elada. Ootame oma meeskonda inimest, kellele läheb korda teiste heaolu ning kes soovib teha tähendusrikast ja vaheldusrikast tööd. Koduhooldustöötajana abistad kliente nende kodus vastavalt individuaalsele abivajadusele ja kokkulepitud hooldusplaanile. Sinu peamised tööülesanded on: *Abistamine igapäevastes hügieenitoimingutes (pesemine, riietumine, tualetitoimingud, mähkmete vahetamine). *Toidu valmistamine, serveerimine ja vajadusel abistamine söömisel. *Kliendi liikumise ja igapäevase aktiivsuse toetamine, abistamine liikumisel ning jalutuskäikudel. *Kergemad kodused majapidamistööd (koristamine, nõude pesemine, pesu- ja voodipesu vahetamine). *Toiduainete ja muude esmatarbekaupade ostmine. *Kliendi saatmine arsti vastuvõtule ja teistele vajalikele käikudele. *Vestlemine ja kliendi sotsiaalse aktiivsuse toetamine. *Tehtud hooldustoimingute dokumenteerimine. Töö toimub klientide kodudes. Tööpäeva jooksul külastatakse vastavalt graafikule ühte või mitut klienti. Külastuste kestus sõltub kliendi abivajadusest. Töö hõlmab hommikusi, päevaseid ja õhtuseid hoolduskülastusi ning vajalik on valmisolek töötada ka öistes vahetustes kliendi kodus.

Omalt poolt pakume: *Tähendusrikast tööd, kus Sinu panus mõjutab otseselt inimeste igapäevast heaolu.*Toetavat ja kokkuhoidvat meeskonda. *Sisseelamisprogrammi, kohapealset juhendamist ja regulaarseid sisekoolitusi. *Paindlikku töögraafikut ning võimalust töötada täis- või osalise tööajaga. *Mitmekesist ja iseseisvat tööd. *Tööks vajalikke vahendeid ja tööriietust. *Võimalust kasutada tööülesannete täitmiseks ametiautot või kokkuleppel isiklikku autot koos sõidukulude hüvitamisega. *Võimalust areneda ja täiendada oma oskusi hooldusvaldkonnas.

Muud nõuded: Nõudmised kandidaadile:*Vähemalt kutseharidus keskhariduse baasil. *Eesti keele oskus vähemalt B2-tasemel. *B-kategooria juhiluba. *Arvutikasutamise baasoskused ja valmisolek kasutada digitaalset hooldustöö dokumenteerimise süsteemi. *Valmisolek töötada graafiku alusel, sealhulgas õhtuti, nädalavahetustel ja vajadusel öösiti kliendi kodus. *Füüsiline ja vaimne valmisolek hooldustööks. OOTAME ESTKEERIGA LIITUMA KUI... *Oled empaatiline, hooliv ja sõbralik. *Oled kohusetundlik, aus ja usaldusväärne. *Suudad töötada nii iseseisvalt kui ka meeskonnas. *Oskad säilitada rahu ja leida lahendusi ka keerulisemates olukordades. *Oled tähelepanelik ning märkad muutusi kliendi enesetundes ja abivajaduses. *Austad kliendi privaatsust, väärikust ja iseseisvust. *Oled paindlik, hea suhtleja ja valmis õppima. *Sul on siiras soov aidata inimesi ja panustada nende elukvaliteedi parandamisse. Kasuks tuleb varasem hooldustöö kogemus või sotsiaal- ja tervishoiuvaldkonna haridus, kuid ootame kandideerima ka inimesi, kellel on sobivad isikuomadused ja soov valdkonnas töötada.

title: Sales Manager – Packaging Equipment and Automated Packaging Solutions
description:
Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Automated packaging lines and packaging equipment.

Work tasks: Alpina Electronics OÜ is expanding its activities in the field of automated packaging equipment and packaging lines and is looking for a Sales Manager for the Estonian and Finnish markets. Your main responsibility will be to identify industrial companies whose production and packaging processes could be automated or made more efficient using our equipment. Our range of solutions includes: Automated packaging lines and equipment in cooperation with the Polish manufacturer RADPAK. Palletizing equipment, including solutions developed by Alpina Electronics. Thermoforming packaging machines for the food industry, primarily for the Finnish market, supplied by Colimatic. Your Key Responsibilities Identifying potential customers and establishing new business relationships in Estonia and Finland. Visiting customers to understand their production processes and packaging requirements. Presenting suitable packaging equipment and automated packaging solutions. Working closely with equipment manufacturers and technical specialists. Managing sales projects from initial customer contact through to order confirmation. Every manufacturing company and project is different. Your role will be to understand each customer's specific needs and work together with our team and the manufacturers' technical specialists to develop the most suitable solution.

We offer: We offer an opportunity to play an active role in establishing a new sales division and developing the market for automated packaging equipment and packaging lines in Estonia and Finland. We offer: A competitive base salary combined with performance-based bonuses. An independent and responsible position with a high degree of autonomy. Flexible working arrangements, including the opportunity to work from home. A company car, computer, mobile phone, and all other necessary work equipment. Comprehensive technical support from equipment manufacturers and our own specialists. Manufacturer-provided training and opportunities to attend international trade fairs. The opportunity to contribute to the development of a new business area and influence the range of solutions we offer. The position involves regular customer visits throughout Estonia and Finland. Administrative and office-based tasks can be carried out from a home office. We prefer a full-time employee but are also open to part-time arrangements for the right candidate.

Other requirements: This position is ideal for someone who values independence, enjoys planning their own work, and wants to see a direct connection between their efforts and achievements.

title: Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor
description:
Were seeking a Senior IT Architect / Strategic Advisor for our client.

Note! This application is only for individuals already residing in Finland, and relocation is not possible.

Background:
Our client is planning a modernization of its production data and industrial IT architecture. The current environment consists of multiple systems, some of which are approaching end-of-life and require replacement or consolidation. The client has already reviewed several vendor solutions and is now looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect to act as an independent, neutral advisor and sparring partner during the assessment and design phase. The consultant will help evaluate the current landscape, identify key challenges and opportunities, and support decision-making regarding future architecture, technology choices, and vendor ecosystem. The objective is a more standardized and controlled architecture that supports operational efficiency, data-driven decision-making, and future AI capabilities.

Responsibilities:
· Assess the current application and architecture landscape.
· Provide independent recommendations on future-state architecture and modernization options.
· Support decision-making related to technology platforms, vendors, and long-term architecture direction.
· Help define the problems to be solved and what the new architecture needs to achieve.
· Facilitate architecture discussions with both business and technical stakeholders.
· Help define architectural principles, priorities, and transformation roadmap.
· Identify opportunities to improve data utilization and prepare the environment for future AI-driven initiatives.
· Bring lessons learned from similar industrial transformation programs.

Requirements:
· Experience with production data and industrial IT architecture.
· Experience as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, including evaluating technology and vendor options neutrally and challenging proposals.
· Proven track record in large-scale industrial, energy, oil & gas, or process industry environments, with references from similar projects.
· Experience with complex enterprise application landscapes, including replacing legacy systems and consolidating them.
· Strong understanding of industrial data ecosystems and IT architecture.

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have senior experience as an Enterprise Architect, IT Architect, or in a similar senior advisory role in oil and gas, energy, or another process or heavy industry?*
- Have you led or advised on the replacement of legacy systems and the consolidation of a complex production data or industrial IT landscape?*
- Have you acted as a strategic advisor or sparring partner to senior decision-makers, evaluating technology or vendor options neutrally?*

Please apply with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role. 

Language: Professional working proficiency in English.
Start date: November / December 2026
Duration: TBC, project to be completed be the end of Q1
Allocation: 50-100 %
Location: Espoo, Finland. Consultant should be ready to come onsite in the beginning of the assignment, after that remote work is possible.

We offer you: We offer a versatile assignment where every day is different and interesting. We also offer a very competitive salary and good employee benefits.

Are you interested in becoming a part of our dynamic team? The position will be filled as soon as a suitable person is found, so please be quick and submit your application! 

Please include your salary expectation in your application. For more information, contact Kimmo Kärsämä, tel. 050 412 7500, kimmo.karsama@lokki.fi

title: Kahvilatyöntekijä, Relove Freda, Helsinki
description: Nyt on loistava mahdollisuus päästä osaksi Reloven Fredalla sijaitsevan kahvilan tiimiä! Etsimme uutta osa-aikaista kahvilatyöntekijää Punavuoren uniikkiin ympäristöön.Relove on kotimainen, arvoihin nojaava perheyritys, joka yhdistää vastuullisen muodin, laadukkaat kahvilatuotteet ja sydämellisen asiakaspalvelun ainutlaatuiseksi kokonaisuudeksi. Me tarjoamme makuelämyksiä sesongin raaka-aineista ja ennen kaikkea kohtaamisia, jotka jäävät mieleen.Kahvilatyöntekijänä olet tärkeässä roolissa luomassa asiakkaille mukavia kahvilahetkiä. Palvelet asiakkaita, työskentelet kassalla ja keittiössä itsenäisesti, valmistat erikoiskahveja, vitriinituotteita ja vaikkapa lounasannoksia sekä pidät huolta viihtyisästä ja siististä ympäristöstä. Huomioithan, että meillä työskennellään kahvilan puolella ajoittain myös yksin.Jotta solahtaisit Reloven monipuoliseen kahvilatoimintaan, edellytetään sinulta useamman vuoden kokemusta kahvila- ja/tai ravintolatyöskentelystä, erinomaisia asiakaspalvelutaitoja, myyntihenkisyyttä sekä kykyä toimia kiireisessä ympäristössä. Mikäli sinulta löytyy aiempaa kokemusta erikoiskahvien valmistuksesta, kerrothan myös tästä hakemuksessasi.Vastapainoa työn hektisyydelle tuovat työn parhaat puolet - ihanat asiakkaat, lämmin ja kannustava työilmapiiri ja sydämelliset kollegat. Relovessa persoonallisuus näkyy niin sisustuksessa, tuotevalikoimassa kuin asiakaspalvelussa eli Sinussa! Lisäksi terveydentilan selvitys salmonellatartunnasta vaaditaan ennen töiden aloitusta.Mikäli jaat arvomme vastuullisuudesta, edelläkävijyydestä sekä lempeydestä, hae mukaan joukkoomme. title: Lärare/socionom i barnomsorg
description: Lemlands kommuns barnomsorg lediganslår nu ordinarie befattningar som lärare i barnomsorg alternativt socionom i barnomsorg.Arbetet inleds i januari eller enligt överenskommelse och anställningarna har inledande placeringar på daghemmet Gullvivan.**Din profil**Vi söker dig som har behörighet som lärare i barnomsorg eller socionom i barnomsorg i enlighet med ÅFS 2020:99. Personliga egenskaper vi värdesätter är att du har god samarbetsförmåga samt är ansvarsfull, flexibel och lösningsfokuserad. Du har ett respektfullt och professionellt förhållningssätt till barn, vårdnadshavare och kollegor och övriga du möter i din yrkesroll. Som person bidrar du till positivitet, lyhördhet och engagemang i verksamheten.I enlighet med landskapslagen (2020:32) om barnomsorg och grundskola är svenska vårt verksamhets- och arbetsspråk, vilket kräver goda kunskaper i tal och skrift.**Din roll hos oss**Som lärare i barnomsorg ansvarar du för det pedagogiska arbetet på din avdelning och för att verksamheten följer aktuella styrdokument. Du arbetar i team med övrig pedagogisk personal på din avdelning, där du har en ledande position, och samarbetar även med resten av personalen på daghemmet samt med speciallärare och övriga sakkunniga. Tillsammans med dina kollegor skapar ni gemensamt kvalitativ småbarnspedagogik där barnet alltid är i fokus. Du handhar även förundervisningen samt ansvarar för samarbetet med barnens vårdnadshavare.Som socionom i barnomsorg ansvarar du i samråd med lärare för det pedagogiska arbetet på din avdelning och för att verksamheten följer aktuella styrdokument. Du arbetar i team med övrig pedagogisk personal på din avdelning, där du har en ledande position och kompletterar med din kunskap om att stärka barnets sociala utveckling och att vid behov stöda familjernas resurser och välmående position. Du samarbetar även med resten av personalen på daghemmet samt med speciallärare och övriga sakkunniga. Tillsammans med dina kollegor skapar ni gemensamt kvalitativ småbarnspedagogik där barnet alltid är i fokus. Du ansvarar även för samarbetet med barnens vårdnadshavare.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och lämplighet.Uppvisat straffregisterutdrag krävs av de som blir valda. En prövotid kan komma att tillämpas.Grundlönen för en heltidsanställd behörig lärare i barnomsorg är 3285,56 €/ månad.Grundlönen för en heltidsanställd socionom i barnomsorg är 3228,16€/ månad.Eventuella erfarenhetstilägg tillkommer.**Vår rekryteringsprocess**Lemlands kommun rekryterar fördomsfritt och objektivt. Intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.Närmare upplysningar angående arbetet och våra daghem ges av Gullvivans föreståndare.Gullvivan: Anu-Riikka Eriksson på tel: 018-349 450**ANSÖKAN** Vi ser fram emot att få din ansökan senast 3 december klockan 23:59. I ansökan vill vi att du har med ett personligt brev och CV som bifogade filer. Ansökan skickas in i första hand via Lemlands kommuns E-tjänster: https://e-tjanster.ax/e-form/sv/c7fa9da3e3Alternativt via postadress: Lemlands Kommun, Kommunrundan 7, 22610 Lemland. Märk ansökan med lärare/socionom i barnomsorg och lärare i förundervisning.**Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!**

title: HR Manager, Scandic, Tukikonttori Espoo
description: JOIN SCANDIC'S HR TEAM!We are looking for an HR Manager to support our Finnish hotels and contribute to Scandics continued success.This is a broad and hands-on HR role, closely connected to our hotel operations. You will work as a trusted advisor to the managers, supporting leaders and teams across the district in day-to-day HR matters like labour law, occupational health care, leadership, staffing and recruitment.This position is located in Finland, with the office in Espoo, Tapiola. At Scandic we believe that strong collaboration, as well as learning and development are best supported through regular in-person interaction and therefore we primarily work from the office.WHAT WE OFFERWe offer you a versatile working environment within a major hotel chain, providing countless opportunities for professional growth and development. Our employee benefits include; food and beverage discounts in our restaurants, ePassi, health care benefits and insurance. Scandic Academy also offers a comprehensive training program, and all employees receive additional job-related training whenever needed.YOUR MISSIONAs HR Manager, you play a key role in supporting both people and business. You are the go-to HR expert in your own field and work closely with managers in people-related matters as well as to ensure great leadership and operational excellence.In this role, you will:\- Act as a key HR partner to leaders in hotel operations from daily coaching to complex HR matters.\- You support correct application of Finnish labor law and collective agreements (MaRa).\- Coach and support managers in matters related to sick leave and work ability, including long-term absences, return-to-work situations and workplace adjustments, working closely with occupational health care and other relevant partners.\- Support and develop managers in all people-related areas like performance, recruitment (including co-operation with our outsourcing partners), culture and leadership.\- Ensure implementation, compliance and continuous improvement of HR processes, based on local needs.\- Promote a healthy, safe and sustainable work environment together with managers and stakeholders.\- Act as a culture ambassador and ensure Scandics values are reflected in leadership and everyday behavior.\- Share insights from your district to help shape the wider HR agenda and ways of working.\- You report to the HR Director Finland and are part of both the country HR team and the larger Scandic HR network.WHO YOU AREIn this role you represent our values Be Caring, Be You, Be a Pro and Be Bold in the following manner:Be Caring – you are open-minded and enjoy collaborating and building trust on all levels of the organization, while helping managers to grow and succeed.Be You – you bring your own wonderful warm and friendly personality in everything you do.Be a Pro – you are structured and proactive and thrive in a high-paced and people-intensive environment.Be Bold – you are confident in your role, bringing strong integrity, self-awareness, drive and clear communication. You are empathic, but also confident enough to challenge others when needed.WHAT YOU BRING\- 5+ years of broad HR experience, with strong understanding in labor law and occupational health care.\- Proven track record in developing work ability management and related KPIs.\- A strong business mindset and the ability to support leaders in aligning people and operations.\- Strong ability to collaborate and build trust on all levels of the organization.\- Support and challenge leaders in a bold and positive way.\- Relevant academic background or equivalent practical experience.\- Full professional fluency in both Finnish and English.Salary: The salary will range between 4500eur-5500eur. The salary offered will be determined based on the candidate's previous experience, qualifications and how well their skills and competencies align with the expectation and requirements of the role.For more information about the position, please contact:HR Director Pia Tuomi 0403549996 during the following times: 16.11.2026 at 16.00-17.00 and 19.11.2026 at 8.00-9.00.Interested? Fantastic!Please apply through the link above. Feel free to send your application in either Finnish or English.Scandic is the leading hotel company in the Nordics. We want to be like a friend in town for people on the road – and friends know what friends need. We believe that great hospitality starts with us, in every role and every interaction. What you do here makes a real difference.A warm welcome, a thoughtful detail or support for a colleague – your actions shape the moments that matter for our guests, for each other and for the world around us. At Scandic, you can be yourself, use your strengths and let your passion create experiences people want to return to. Together, we make everyone feel welcome and at home – just like friends do.

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja | CABB, Kokkola
description: Haemme **Kokkolan tuotantolaitoksellemme kunnossapitoasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen** osaksi mekaanisen kunnossapidon tiimiämme.**Keskeiset tehtäväsi**Työskentelet monipuolisissa kunnossapidon tehtävissä, jotka sisältävät korjaavaa ja ennakoivaa kunnossapitoa ennakkohuoltosuunnitelmien mukaisesti. description: Haetaan: autoasentaja / automekaanikkoHaetaan osaavaa autoasentajaa monimerkkikorjaamolle Espoon Muuralaan. title: On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal
description: We are looking for an On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal, with the main responsibility of assisting our teams with various tax and legal matters. The position is estimated to involve approximately two working days per week. The preferred location for this position is Helsinki, Finland. We offer the possibility of hybrid work.As an On-Call Trainee, you can work up to 25 hours per week. The person selected for this role needs to be a full-time student studying for a degree in Finland.Your role and responsibilitiesAs an On-Call Trainee, Corporate Tax and Legal, your work will include tasks related to income tax, transfer pricing, international tax matters, indirect tax, as well as other tasks within the Group Tax team and tasks within the Corporate & M&A Legal team. Youll be working as part of the Group Tax team and the Corporate & M&A Legal team in a truly international environment. You will probably start many of your tasks by checking Google Maps to see where the relevant company is located, as Wärtsilä has companies or branches in over 100 countries.To succeed in the position, we expect you to have: * Late-stage Bachelors or mid- to late-stage Masters level studies in Economics and Business Administration, Law, or a similar field * Interest in taxation and motivation to learn about income tax, transfer pricing, indirect tax, and international taxation * Interest in gaining insight into and participating in corporate legal work * Excellent communication and writing skills in English; Finnish or Swedish language skills are considered an advantage * Some relevant previous work experience; experience in taxation and/or law is a plus but not mandatory * An organised, focused, and proactive working style with a flexible and positive attitude * Experience using various IT systems and tools, especially Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; experience with SAP is an advantageWhats in it for you? * The opportunity to learn about taxation and law, and the roles and responsibilities of the Tax and Legal functions of an international listed company * Induction and training, professional development within the fields of tax and law, and valuable hands-on experience * The opportunity to become a valued and integral member of the Group Tax team, with support for your studies and future career, as well as the opportunity to participate in and become integrated into the tasks of the Corporate & M&A Legal team * Flexible working hours and the possibility to work partly remotelyWhy you and us?We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership, and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking for a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.Contact & next stepsWe hope to hear from you soon and receive your application via our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated throughout the process.For further information regarding this position, please reach out to Jouni Arpalahti, Director, Corporate Taxes, at jouni.arpalahti@wartsila.com regarding this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications by email will not be recorded or responded to).Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!

title: Supplier Development Engineer
description: We are looking for a Supplier Development Engineer with main responsibilities around different commodities – castings, forgings and metal constructions. The preferred location for this position is Vaasa, Finland, but other Wärtsilä locations in Finland and Trieste, Italy are negotiable. We offer the possibility of hybrid remote work.Your role and responsibilitiesAs a Supplier Development Engineer, youll be working as part of an impactful Supplier Development team and Category team plans to improve supplier performance * Supporting suppliers with their operational development initiatives in relation to quality, delivery and cost * Executing supplier audits and audit follow-up according to the supplier development action plan and verifying the impactRequirements for the position: * Strong technical expertise in castings, forgings or metal constructions, with a solid understanding of the relevant manufacturing processes, technologies, and key factors affecting product quality and manufacturability * Good understanding of quality management principles, processes, and tools * Excellent communication skills * Strong personal drive for identifying development potential and proven skills in leading improvement projects or initiatives successfully within cross-functional teams * Performance-focused mindset and capability to make an impact on increasing the performance level * A systematic way of working and excellent problem-solving skills * Capability to apply lean principles and statistical process control in daily work to drive improvementTo be able to succeed in the position, we expect you to have: * M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Engineering or Economics, or equivalent education * Fluency in English, both verbal and written * Willingness to travel * Experience within the Production Part Approval Process / experience in quality management, for example in manufacturing processes * Previous auditing experience or a lead auditor qualification (e.g., ISO 9001) * Strong experience with Six Sigma (Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent)Why you and us?We at Wärtsilä believe in empowerment, ownership and taking responsibility for our work. We support each others growth, and co-creation is the true basis of our innovation. We have the courage to see opportunities and take initiative.We are authentic and honest, and we strongly believe that by being your own true self, you can accomplish so much more. We dont always get it right the first time, and if mistakes are made, we make sure to learn and grow from them. We want everyone to voice their opinions freely. That is why we have built an environment that empowers you and everyone around you, and where you can feel safe and cared for. Are you eager to be part of this ambition?We have an amazing team, and we are excited about our work and the impact it has on building sustainable societies. We are looking for a colleague with this shared passion for smart technologies and a sustainable future.Contact & next stepsWe hope to hear from you soon through your application submitted via our Careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.For further questions, please reach out to Henna Mäkinen, Supplier Development Manager, at henna.makinen@wartsila.com regarding this position (only for questions from direct job applicants; applications by email will not be recorded or responded to).Welcome to join us in shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy!The primary location for this role is Finland, but this role can also be based in Italy where the annual salary range would be 40 000 EUR – 47 743 EUR in accordance with the salary provisions in the applicable National Collective Labor Agreement for workers in the metalworking and plant installation industry (CCNL Metalmeccanico).At Wärtsilä, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The salary range shared reflects the expected compensation for this role in that location, based on market data and our job architecture. The final salary will be influenced by factors such as the scope and responsibilities of the role, the required competencies, and your relevant education, skills, and experience, and the salary provisions in the applicable Collective Bargaining Agreement. We also take internal equity into account to ensure a fair and consistent approach across our organisation.

title: Putkihitsaaja

title: Kunnossapitoasentaja

title: Mekaaninen asentaja (Rauma)
description: Reilumpaa ja palkitsevampaa työnvälitystä! Vuonna 2018 perustetun yrityksemme tavoitteena on tarjota mielenkiintoisia työmahdollisuuksia Uudellamaalla sekä Varsinais-Suomessa. Kauttamme löydät eri pituisia tehtäviä niin raskailta aloilta kuin toimistoympäristössä. Kurota siis hunajapurkkiin ja löydä uusi työsi!Meidät löydät livenä sekä netistä. Tule moikkaamaan!TehtävänkuvausHaemme asiakkaallemme Raumalle mekaanista asentajaa pitkäkestoiseen työsuhteeseen. Työtehtävääsi kuuluu koneiden kokoonpano ja laitteiden asennustehtävät. Työt alkavat 6 kuukauden määräaikaisuudella, jonka jälkeen sopivalle työntekijälle tarjotaan vakituista paikkaa. Töitä tehdään arkipäivisin päivävuorossa klo 8-16. Työtä tehdään 37,5h/vk. Jos haluat päästä työskentelemään osana ammattimaista työporukkaa, niin hae mukaan!Toivomme sinultaSinulla on työhön soveltuva koulutus (esim. raskaan kaluston, autonasentajan tai metallialan), teknisten piirusten lukutaitoa ja aikaisempaa työkokemusta muutaman vuoden ajalta. Pärjäät työssäsi itsenäisesti ja työnjälkesi on laadukasta. Olet innokas ja sinulta löytyy motivaatiota. Olet yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat kantaa vastuuta. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.Tarjoamme sinulleTarjoamme työntekijöillemme aina osaamiseen perustuvan, kuitenkin vähintään teknologiateollisuuden TES:n mukaisen palkkauksen. Kunnolliset työvälineet ovat kunnian asia, ja tiimimme tukee sinua kaikissa työsuhdeasioissa.Kiinnostuitko tehtävästä?Hae tehtävää heti, tai vinkkaa kaverillesi! Hae heti klikkaamalla painiketta "Hae työpaikkaa". Muista liittää mahdollinen CV ja muut liitteet. Lisätietoja tehtävästä voi kysyä lähettämällä meille sähköpostia (joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi). Hakuprosessista vastaa Joona Mäki.Jos et löytänyt etsimääsi työpaikkaa, niin voit jättää meille myös avoimen hakemuksen. Mikäli taitosi ja profiilisi sopii jonkun asiakkaamme tarpeeseen, niin otamme sinuun yhteyttä!Contio HenkilöstöpalvelutSähköposti: joona.maki@contiopalvelut.fi Sijainti: Rauma

title: Huoltoasentaja, Algol Technics Oy, Tampere
description: _Algol Technics on teollisuuden kumppani ja materiaalinkäsittelyn asiantuntija. Algol Technics on osa suomalaista Algol-konsernia, jolla on kokemusta kansainvälisestä kaupasta vuodesta 1894 alkaen. Uskomme, että asiakkaidemme maailma automatisoituu, nopeutuu ja muuttuu aiempaa kompleksisemmaksi. Olemme vahvasti mukana tässä muutoksessa tarjoten asiakkaillemme sisälogistiikan ratkaisuja, mm. nostureita, robottisoluja, kuljettimia ja automaatiovarastoja sekä laajan valikoiman teknisiä tuotteita. Kaikkiin toimittamiimme ratkaisuihin tarjoamme kattavat kunnossapito- ja huoltopalvelut.__Algol-konsernin yhteistyökumppaniverkosto on maailmanlaajuinen ja yhtiöllä on toimipisteitä yhdeksässä eri maassa. Konsernin vuoden 2025 liikevaihto oli 198 MEUR. Työllistämme noin 503 ammattilaista._Oletko sähköalan tai huollon ja kunnossapidon kokenut tekijä? Lue eteenpäin, mitä Algol Technicsillä on tarjolla ja työllisty heidän kirjoilleen!**Mitä tulisit tässä tehtävässä tekemään?**Kunnossapidon ja huollon tavoitteena on pitää laitteistot toiminnassa keskeytyksittä. Algol Technicsin huoltoverkosto huolehtii siitä, että huoltotyöt sekä käynnissäpito hoidetaan ammattimaisesti ympäri Suomen.Huoltoasentajana Algol Technicsillä työskentelet monipuolisissa huolto-, kunnossapito- ja asennustehtävissä eri asiakaskohteissa Tampereen alueella. Halutessasi voit työskennellä myös laajemmalla alueella, asiakaskohteissa liikkumiseen saat Algolilta käyttöösi auton. Työnkuvaan kuuluu teollisuusnostureiden huoltoja, asennuksia, käyttöönottoja ja tarkastuksia. Lisäksi tehtäviisi voi kuulua nostoapuvälineiden tarkastuksia sekä sähköautomaatioon, nosto-oviin ja jonkin verran robotiikkaan liittyviä töitä.Tehtävässä huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaiden laitteet toimivat turvallisesti ja tuotanto pysyy liikkeessä. Työhösi voi sisältyä myös myynnin teknistä tukea sekä asiakkaiden opastamista ja kouluttamista. Työ on itsenäistä, ja pääset suunnittelemaan sekä aikatauluttamaan omia työpäiviäsi.Halutessasi voit toimia myös huoltopäivystäjänä, josta saat asianmukaiset korvaukset. Algolilla työskentelet osana osaavaa tiimiä, jolta saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään.**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**Tarjoamme sinulle mielenkiintoisen vakituisen työn ja TES:n mukaisen palkan, jonka lisäksi sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvattaa ansioitasi vapaaehtoisella lisämyynnillä. Ympärilläsi on rennot työkaverit, työyhteisön tuki sekä erinomaiset mahdollisuudet omaan ammatilliseen kasvuun ja kehittämiseen. Työaikasi on arkisin 7:00–15.30. Algolilla saat käyttöösi laajan työterveydenhuollon ja hyvinvointiasi ovat tukemassa E-passin palvelut, sekä säännölliset tykypäivät.Algol-konserni on innostava työpaikka. Arvomme, vastuunotto, yhteistyö ja kehitys, ohjaavat kaikkea työtämme. Arvojen lisäksi vastuullisuus on meille tärkeää. Jokainen Algolilainen vaikuttaa siihen, millainen jälki toiminnallamme on. Meillä uskaltaa kehittää ja kehittyä. Algol huolehtii myös, että työssäsi tarvittavat luvat ja sertifikaatit pysyvät ajan tasalla.**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**Etsimme henkilöä, jolla on sähköasentajan koulutus ja aiempaa kokemusta sähköasennuksista tai huolto- ja kunnossapidosta. Alan koulutuksen ja kokemuksen lisäksi sinulla on rautainen asenne työntekoon sekä halu oppia ja kehittyä. Olet tärkeä osa asiakasyhteistyötä, joten toivomme sinulta palveluhenkisyyttä sekä omatoimisuutta. Kohtaat työssäsi haasteita ja vaihtelevia tilanteita, joten aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi on etua. Turvallisuussyistä tehtävässä vaatimuksena on sujuva suomen kielen taito.

 platform architecture, security, compliance, integration patterns and enables business to use the platform. 
 platform architecture, security, compliance, integration patterns and enables business to use the platform.

title: Digital Growth Marketing Manager
description: _Fastems is a global partner for machining manufacturers, delivering intelligent automation for cutting machine tools and surrounding processes. We are a family-owned business with 40 years of automation experience, over 5000 installations and main markets in Europe, North America and Asia. Our mission is to help metalworking manufacturers improve their productivity and profitability. Globally, there are already 450 of us learning, growing and prospering together. At Fastems you get to work with some of the brightest people in the industry, so every day is an opportunity to learn something new._We are looking for a **Digital Growth Marketing Manager** to join our global marketing team and drive growth through digital channels. You will own our growth marketing engine and keep optimizing and improving it based on data and AI. We are looking for someone who really loves digital marketing, has a proactive working style, and thinks systematically and creatively. You bring a positive attitude, a collaborative mindset and a good sense of humour. A little spark in your eyes doesnt hurt either.**What will you get to work on?****Marketing automation & CRM**You will own and continuously develop our lead pipeline in Salesforce Sales Cloud, helping marketing and sales work smoothly together. You will also support localized prospecting activities and develop marketing automation, lead nurturing and customer engagement journeys across Marketing Cloud and Service Cloud.**Website, SEO & GEO**You will take ownership of our new website (which will be published soon) built on WordPress, and develop it further with our web partner. Your focus is SEO and GEO visibility, digital customer journeys, conversion and analytics – ensuring a site that drives engagement.**Growth marketing**You will drive demand generation through LinkedIn, Meta, SEO/GEO, SEM, and other digital channels. You create, run, measure and optimize campaigns based on collected data. The target is qualified demand and a real contribution to sales, not just traffic.**Marketing AI**You will lead the development of our marketing AI strategy and turn promising ideas into practical solutions. You will identify where AI creates business value, help define the required data, technologies and integrations, and work with partners to make it happen. Quality, security and human oversight remain important throughout.**Analytics & performance**You will build visibility across the marketing and sales funnel. Your insights will help us understand what creates qualified demand, what converts, what needs improvement and where we should invest next.**Who will you work with?**You will have a lot of ownership, but you are not on your own. You work closely with colleagues in marketing, sales, product management, and with external partners. You are in charge of digital strategy and implementation, working closely with your teammates who lead content creation.**What will you bring with you?**- A hands-on digital marketing enthusiast who thinks systemically, enjoys working with data and technology and wants to understand what really drives business results - Strategic and analytical person who can both plan and execute - Curiosity about AI, marketing technology and new ways of working - with business value first in mind - Good project management and teamwork skills - Proactive and independent way of working - 5+ years of experience in digital marketing, growth marketing, MarTech or a similar role - Fluent in English and at least basic Finnish skills for everyday workplace - Experience in international B2B marketing of technically complex products, manufacturing or industrial automation is a plus **Location and ways of working**Our office is located in **Lahdesjärvi, Tampere**. We offer flexible hybrid working and the possibility to work partly remotely. However, this role also requires regular on-site presence in Tampere to support close collaboration with the team and key stakeholders.**We can offer you:**- A key role in shaping digital growth at a global industrial automation company. - Fastems strong company culture expressed through our values. - Career and development opportunities. - International work atmosphere and global activities. - Flexible working hours and possibility to work partly remotely. - Comprehensive employee benefits, such as culture and lunch benefit at the office. **Interested in joining #fastemsians?**For more information about the position and the recruitment process, please contact:Teemu-Pekka Ahonen / Head of Product Management & Marketing: teemu.ahonen@fastems.comSend your application together with your CV and salary request **by November 29th at the latest.** Please note that even though the application deadline is not reached, we may proceed with interviews and make a hire as soon as a suitable candidate is identified.

title: Apulaisravintolapäällikkö, Rue Madame, Helsinki
description: Rue Madamessa ihmiset ovat kaiken keskiössä. Uskomme, että juuri ihmiset luovat ravintolan sielun. Rakennamme työyhteisöä, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä, onnistua ja tuntea olevansa tärkeä osa porukkaa.Etsimme nyt Rue Madamen tiimiin osaavaa ja lämminhenkistä apulaisravintolapäällikköä.Apulaisravintolapäällikön roolissa varmistat ravintolan arjen sujuvuuden. Johdat, perehdytät ja valmennat henkilöstöä sekä osallistut itse aktiivisesti salityöskentelyyn. Toimit ravintolapäällikön läheisenä työparina palvelukulttuurin, asiakaskokemuksen, myynnin ja kannattavuuden kehittämiseksi.Viinit ovat tärkeä osa vastuutasi: suunnittelet, kehität ja ylläpidät viinimenua yhdessä ravintolapäällikön kanssa. Tuot osaamisesi asiakkaiden iloksi, myynnin tueksi ja tiimin viinituntemuksen vahvistamiseksi.Tarjoamme sinulle- Kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen Rue Madamen kirjoilla- Vastuullisen ja käytännönläheisen roolin ravintolapäällikön työparina- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa ravintolan toimintaan ja viinivalikoimaan- Työyhteisön, jossa ihmiset ja yhdessä onnistuminen ovat etusijalla- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan (palkkahaitari 2 800-3 700 €) kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi huomioiden- Monipuoliset työsuhde-edut (mm. työterveyshuolto, ePassi flex, alennuksia Reloven ja Rue Madamen tuotteista itselle ja pöytäseurueelle)Odotamme sinulta- Pitkää ja monipuolista ravintola-alan kokemusta sekä aiempaa esihenkilökokemusta- Vahvaa viinituntemusta ja halukkuutta hyödyntää sitä käytännössä (sommelierin koulutus katsotaan eduksesi, mutta ei ole edellytys)- Empaattista ja jämäkkää johtamista, jolla luot ympärillesi vakautta ja hyvää energiaa- Oma-aloitteisuutta, kehittämismyönteisyyttä ja aitoa intoa ravintola-alaa kohtaanTehtävä edellyttää lisäksi- Sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa (suomen kielen osaaminen on etu, ei vaatimus)- Hygienia- ja anniskelupassia sekä terveydentilan selvitystä salmonellatartunnasta- Valmiutta työskennellä aamu- ja iltavuoroissa maanantaista sunnuntaihin ravintolan aukioloaikojen mukaisesti (klo 08-24 välillä)Kuulostaako tämä sinun seuraavalta askeleeltasi? Jos haluat yhdistää ihmisten johtamisen, viiniosaamisen ja ravintolan arjessa tekemisen, haluamme kuulla sinusta hakemuksen muodossa! Lähetä tietosi meille mahdollisimman pian, sillä tehtävä täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.Jätäthän hakemuksen hakulomakkeen kautta, sillä emme voi tietoturvasyistä huomioida sähköpostitse jätettyjä hakemuksia. Hakeaksesi avoimia työpaikkoja, sinun tulee luoda työnhakuprofiili Barona Careersiin. Täytät profiilisi vain kerran, minkä jälkeen voit hakea kaikkia Baronan työpaikkoja samalla profiililla.***Assistant Restaurant Manager, Rue Madame, HelsinkiAt Rue Madame, people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that people are what give a restaurant its soul. We are building a workplace where everyone can be themselves, succeed and feel like a valued part of the team.We are looking for a skilled and warm-hearted Assistant Restaurant Manager to join the Rue Madame team.As Assistant Restaurant Manager, you will ensure the smooth day-to-day running of the restaurant. You will lead, onboard and coach the team while actively working on the restaurant floor yourself. You will work closely with the Restaurant Manager to develop our service culture, customer experience, sales and profitability.Wine will be an important part of your responsibilities: you will plan, develop and maintain the wine list together with the Restaurant Manager. You will use your expertise to delight our guests, support sales and strengthen the teams wine knowledge.What we offer- A full-time, permanent position employed directly by Rue Madame- A hands-on role with responsibility, working closely with the Restaurant Manager- The opportunity to influence the restaurants operations and wine selection- A workplace where people and shared success come first- A fixed monthly salary (€2,800-€3,700), based on your experience and skills- A wide range of employee benefits (including occupational healthcare, ePassi Flex, and discounts on Relove and Rue Madame products for you and your dining party)What we expect from you- Extensive and varied experience in the restaurant industry, along with previous supervisory experience- Strong wine knowledge and a willingness to put it into practice (sommelier training is an advantage but not a requirement)- An empathetic yet firm leadership style that creates stability and positive energy around you- Initiative, an openness to development and a genuine passion for the restaurant industryThe role also requires- Fluent English (Finnish language skills are an advantage, not a requirement)- A hygiene passport, an alcohol passport and a health certificate regarding salmonella infection- Availability to work morning and evening shifts from Monday to Sunday, in line with the restaurants opening hours (between 08:00 and 24:00)Could this be your next step? If you want to combine people leadership, wine expertise and hands-on work in the day-to-day running of a restaurant, we would love to receive your application! Submit your application as soon as possible, as the position will be filled once a suitable candidate is found.Please apply using the application form, as we cannot consider applications submitted by email for data security reasons. To apply for open positions, you need to create a jobseeker profile on Barona Careers. You only need to complete your profile once, after which you can use it to apply for any Barona vacancy.

title: FA Solutions: Solution Consultant (Fintech SaaS, Riga or Helsinki)
description: **Type**: Full-time, permanent**Location:** Helsinki / Riga**Application deadline:** 29.11.2026Are you passionate about finance, technology and helping clients succeed? Join FA Solutions growing team as a **Solution Consultant** and turn complex business needs into practical solutions!FA Solutions is a market leading provider of software for Asset & Wealth Managers, helping them manage their investments globally. The company offers a cloud-based Portfolio Management solution that automates and centralizes a wide range of operational processes into one easy-to-use FA Platform.FA Solutions is committed to delivering a robust and scalable solution that prioritises user experience, data security, and compliance, allowing the client companies to leverage the power of open architecture and interoperability.**What will you be doing?**As a Solution Consultant, you will play a central role in helping FAs new clients to start running their business on FA platform and to help FAs existing clients to get the most out of the FA system capabilities.The role combines project management, investment management knowledge and technical problem-solving, with a strong emphasis on client relationships and delivering business value.**Your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle:**- Taking ownership of designing new client-specific solutions by mapping business requirements with the platforms capabilities and best practices - Configuring and customizing the platform to meet client needs, including light scripting and data migration - Coordinating implementation projects, communicating progress, and ensuring delivery quality - Conducting workshops and training sessions for client users - Contributing to improvement projects for existing clients, from gap analysis to delivery You'll collaborate closely with account management, product management, customer support and delivery partners, while maintaining an active dialogue with clients throughout the projects.You will manage several long-term projects simultaneously and work closely with clients, particularly in the UK and Iceland.**What makes you a great fit?**You will work with various stakeholders and clients, which highlights the importance of excellent communication and collaboration skills. As your work will cover the full delivery lifecycle, you'll also need basic project management skills, a structured way of working, and the ability to deliver training sessions and host workshops.You might be the talent we are looking for if you enjoy bringing people, processes and technology together. You can confidently lead client discussions, structure complex requirements and keep projects moving forward. You are curious about how financial businesses operate and motivated to learn new software solutions. You do not need to be a programmer to succeed in this role.**We require you to have:**- Minimum 2 years of experience in consulting, software implementation, professional services or client-facing project delivery - Good understanding of financial services or investment management, or a strong interest in developing your expertise in the field - A genuine interest in working with clients and the ability to succeed in a customer-facing environment - Experience coordinating projects, managing stakeholders and translating business requirements into practical solutions - A full professional proficiency and presentation skills in English **We consider as an asset:**- Experience in investment management industry - Knowledge of Agile and Waterfall project methodologies - Experience with Jira or similar project management tools - Some experience in scripting (Java, JavaScript, SQL or similar) **FA Solutions offers you:**- The opportunity to own meaningful client projects and see how your work improves financial institutions' everyday operations - A collaborative international team where you can learn from experienced colleagues and work with clients across different markets - Room to grow into a senior consulting, team leadership or specialist role as your expertise develops - The flexibility and speed of a startup, backed by the resources and stability of an established company - Flexible working hours and remote work policy - Auntie well-being service, occupational health care in Finland, health insurance in Latvia - Bonus model **Practicalities:**This is a full-time and permanent position, in which you will be employed directly to FA Solutions.You will join the Professional Services team either in **Helsinki, Finland,** or **Riga, Latvia**, depending on your current location and preference. The role also includes a flexible hybrid arrangement. The role involves occasional international travel, particularly to the UK and Iceland, depending on client projects.The preferred starting date is as soon as possible.Salary in this position is approximately 3000-4500 €/month based on your experience.**Does this sound like the next step in your career?**Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English latest by the 29th of November via aTalent's application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/397753/create/.Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received.
