title: Ekonomibiträde
description: I Svenljunga har vi den lilla kommunens fördelar; Nära till varandra, till idéerna och till besluten. Vi som arbetar här gör det för att vi vill ge bästa möjliga service till våra invånare. Som arbetsgivare värnar vi om din livskvalitet, för oss är det viktigt att du som anställd trivs och mår bra. Därför satsar vi på bra arbetsvillkor, ett gott ledarskap och uppmuntrar ditt engagemang. Vi värdesätter din unika kunskap och erfarenhet. Vi ser fram emot att du är delaktig i utvecklingsarbetet av våra verksamheter.Det händer mycket spännande utveckling i vår kommun och vår organisation. Nu fokuserar vi särskilt mycket på barn och ungdomar. Vi har genomfört vår största satsning på skolor någonsin och byggt två moderna skolor i södra kommundelen. Vår uppskattade Familjecentral får snart sällskap av en Barn- och ungdomscentral.Hos oss är vi stolta över vår kommun och vårt arbete. Svenljunga kommun - vi erbjuder det godaste livet!1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom ekonomibiträde arbetar du inom kommunens kostverksamhet i ett mottagningskök på en förskola.Arbetsuppgifterna består av:Förberedelse och enklare tillagning av måltider samt hämta maten från tillagningsköket. Servering och bemötande av elever eller omsorgstagare och personal, disk, städning, hantering av specialkost. Beställningar och månadsredovisningar.Egenkontroll, livsmedelshygien och följsamhet till gällande riktlinjer.KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som har erfarenhet av service inom restaurang eller storkök eller annan  erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och är serviceinriktad, ansvarstagande, flexibel samt stresstålig. B körkort är ett krav eftersom du kommer att transportera mat mellan enheter. Dina personliga egenskaper kommer att vara av stor betydelse.Löneform: Månadslön.Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2026-12-01  Enligt överenskommelse., upphör: 2027-06-30  .Arbetstid: Dagtid. Måndag till fredagDina personuppgifter kommer att användas inom Svenljunga kommun och av personer som arbetar med rekrytering. Det är den nämnd som står för rekryteringen som är personuppgiftsansvarig och ansvarar för behandlingen av personuppgifter. Vill du veta vem det är som är personuppgiftsansvarig för dina uppgifter kan du kontakta oss via kommun@svenljunga.se eller 0325-180 00. Syftet med behandlingen av personuppgifter är för att de ska användas för rekryteringsändamål. Den rättsliga grunden är samtycke för att kunna administrera och dokumentera rekryteringsprocessen. De uppgifter som kommer att lagras och sparas med anledning av överklagande förfarandet är uppgifter du själv angett, ditt CV, ditt personliga brev samt eventuell övrig information som du anger till oss. Vi gallrar dina uppgifter efter 2 år.Har du synpunkter på hur vi behandlar dina personuppgifter eller om du anser att de står i strid med dataskyddsregelverken bör du informera oss snarast. Detta kan du göra genom att ta kontakt med oss via kommun@svenljunga.se eller 0325-180 00 eller vårt dataskyddsombud. Du kan också lämna in ett klagomål till Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten (imy@imy.se).Enligt lag så är det krav att begära ut belastningsregister vid anställning inom skola/förskola och funktionshinder. Inför anställning är vi skyldiga att begära in ett aktuellt utdrag ur belastningsregistret.Om du vill läsa mer om dina rättigheter eller hur vi behandlar dina personuppgifter kan du läsa det på vår webbplats. https://svenljunga.se/ovrigt/om-personuppgifterVarmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Projekteringsledare Byggnadsverk - Göteborg
description: Projekteringsledare Byggnadsverk – Västlänken, Haga, Delprojekt RosenlundVill du leda projekteringen av några av Sveriges mest komplexa och samhällsviktiga anläggningskonstruktioner?Kraftsam Rekrytering & Bemanning söker nu en erfaren Projekteringsledare Byggnadsverk för ett konsultuppdrag inom Trafikverkets Västlänken, projekt Haga, delprojekt Rosenlund.I rollen ansvarar du för att leda och samordna projekteringen av permanenta byggnadsverk, där fokus ligger på betongtunnel och stationsbyggnad för den nya underjordiska stationen Haga. Du blir en nyckelperson i ett multidisciplinärt projekt med omfattande samverkan mellan beställare, entreprenörer och tekniska specialister.Uppdraget är placerat i Göteborg och kräver fysisk närvaro på Trafikverkets projektkontor fem dagar i veckan. Omfattningen är 80–100 % av heltid.Om företagetTrafikverket ansvarar för utvecklingen av Sveriges transportsystem och driver några av landets största infrastrukturprojekt. Västlänken är en cirka åtta kilometer lång järnvägstunnel under centrala Göteborg som skapar genomgående pendel- och regiontågstrafik genom staden. Projekt Haga omfattar bland annat tunnelanläggningar och en ny underjordisk station mitt i Göteborgs centrum.Om rollenSom Projekteringsledare Byggnadsverk leder och styr du projekteringsuppdrag kopplade till framtagning av bygghandlingar för permanenta byggnadsverk inom delprojekt Rosenlund. Du arbetar nära projektledning, entreprenörer och projekterande konsulter för att säkerställa att tekniska lösningar är genomförbara, kostnadseffektiva och uppfyller projektets krav på kvalitet, tid och ekonomi.Du blir en del av en grupp projekteringsledare som leds av en övergripande projekteringsledare och rapporterar till denna funktion.Roll och ansvar    Planera och leda projekteringsarbetet tillsammans med upphandlade konsulter.    Säkerställa projekteringens innehåll, framdrift och leveranser.    Leda projekteringsarbetet i samverkan med entreprenör för att skapa effektiva och genomförbara tekniska lösningar.    Planera, leda och dokumentera projekteringsmöten.    Identifiera, analysera och hantera tekniska frågeställningar, gränssnitt och kritiska moment.    Medverka i projektets riskhantering.    Säkerställa att myndighetskrav, lagkrav och Trafikverkets regelverk efterlevs.    Leda granskningsprocesser samt samordna mottagningskontroller och konstruktionsredovisning.    Hantera gränssnitt mellan olika delprojekt inom Haga och övriga projekt inom Västlänken.    Säkerställa att externa intressenters krav integreras i projekteringen.    Stödja projekt- och byggledning under entreprenadskedet vid omprojektering, tekniska utredningar och ändrade förutsättningar.    Delta i tid- och produktionsplanering.Kompetenskrav1. Högskole- eller civilingenjörsexamen inom samhällsbyggnad, väg- och vatten eller motsvarande teknisk utbildning.2. Minst 4 års dokumenterad erfarenhet som projekteringsledare i anläggningsprojekt med omfattande samordning mellan beställare, entreprenör och projekterande konsulter.3. Minst 2 års erfarenhet som projekteringsledare i större anläggningsprojekt i stadsmiljö med entreprenadkostnad över 500 miljoner kronor.4. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av arbetsmiljöarbete under projekteringsskedet.5. God kännedom om Trafikverkets tekniska regelverk TRVK Bro och Tunnel.6. God kunskap om entreprenadjuridik såsom AB, ABT, ABK samt AMA Anläggning och MER.7. God kommunikativ förmåga i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.8. Goda kunskaper i Microsoft Office.Mervärdeskrav1. Erfarenhet av konstruktionsarbete, dimensionering eller verifiering enligt Eurokod för betongtunnlar, betongtråg eller motsvarande konstruktioner.2. Erfarenhet av att leda och samordna multidisciplinär projektering vid tekniska förändringar eller ändringshantering i sent projekteringsskede eller under pågående produktion.Uppdragsinformation    Uppdragsperiod: 2 år från uppdragsstart.    Option: Möjlighet till förlängning 1 + 1 år.    Start: Enligt överenskommelse, snarast möjligt efter avtalstecknande (senast 8 veckor efter avtalstecknande).    Omfattning: 80–100 % (ca 1 700 timmar/år)    Placeringsort: Göteborg.    Arbetsplats: Trafikverkets projektkontor på Rosenlundsgatan.    Närvaro: Fysisk närvaro krävs fem dagar per vecka.Om KraftsamKraftsam Rekrytering & Bemanning hjälper företag och offentliga verksamheter att hitta rätt kompetens för både specialist- och ledande roller. Genom personligt engagemang, hög kvalitet och nära samarbete skapar vi långsiktiga matchningar mellan arbetsgivare och kandidater. Vi arbetar med rekrytering, bemanning och konsultlösningar över hela Sverige.AnsökanSkicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt då tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.Har du frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på anbud@kraftsam.se.Välkommen med din ansökan!Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-12-09

title: Lärare 4-6 MA/NO, Tröingeskolan
description: Här i Falkenbergs kommun kan du göra stor skillnad. Vårt jobb är att erbjuda god kommunal service i livets alla skeden. Vi är också med och utvecklar Falkenberg som plats. Vår vision är att vi växer för en hållbar framtid.I Falkenbergs kommun strävar vi efter att alla barn och elever ska nå målen med utbildningen och utveckla en positiv lärandeidentitet. För att nå dit har vi en gemensam och tydlig riktning i vårt arbete kallad Utbildning Falkenberg. Utbildning Falkenberg vilar på övertygelsen att alla barn och elever kan och vill lära och gör rätt om de kan. Det är i stället undervisningens kvalitet som avgör om barn och elever når målen med undervisningen och utvecklar en positiv lärandeidentitet. Genom att ha tydliga förväntningar på olika professioner, möta våra barn och elever utifrån ett relationellt förhållningssätt samt ge dem möjlighet att delta i en undervisning som är tillgänglig, formativ och kollaborativ tror vi att undervisningskvaliteten i våra förskolor och skolor kan förbättras. För bra kvalitet kan alltid bli bättre.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERNu söker vi en driven lärare för åk 4-6 med behörighet att undervisa i matematik, NO och annat ämne.Som lärare på nya Tröingeskolan är du med med och bygger framtidens skola! Tillsammans skapar vi Tröingeskolan, en skola där alla elever är allas elever.Läsåret 25/26 öppnade vi dörrarna till vår nybyggda F-9 skola i Falkenberg. Läsåret 26/27 har vi elever i årskurser F-8 och växer under kommande läsår till en F-9 skola.I vår skola genomsyrar trygghet, nyfikenhet och gemenskap allt vi gör. Den nybyggda Tröingeskolan i tre våningar kombinerar den stora skolans möjligheter med känslan av en mindre skola genom hemvister och inspirerande lärmiljöer. Vi tror på att:     • Eleven står i centrum: undervisningen anpassas efter varje elevs behov och möjligheter.    • Tillsammans är nyckeln: vi tar gemensamt ansvar för elevernas lärande och utveckling.    • Trygghet och studiero: en strukturerad skolmiljö med tydliga förväntningar och ett gott bemötande ger eleverna de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas.Din roll som lärare och en del av vårt team:    • Planerar och genomför du din undervisning med hög kvalitet och tydlig struktur.    • Arbetar du relationellt och skapar en tillgänglig lärmiljö.    • Använder du digitala verktyg som en naturlig del av undervisningen.    • Är du en del av en skola där alla elever är allas elever och där vi stöttar och utvecklar varandra som ett team.Tillsammans med arbetslaget planerar, genomför, utvärderar och utvecklar ni undervisningen utifrån skolans styrdokument och mål.Som lärare är du med och utvecklar skolans pedagogiska verksamhet. Du är en tydlig och strukturerad ledare i klassrummet med goda pedagogiska färdigheter i undervisningen. Du har höga förväntningar på eleverna och kan genom att tydliggöra målen och kunskapskraven motivera dem att nå goda resultat i skolarbetet.KVALIFIKATIONERLärarlegitimation med behörighet för åk 4-6 i ma/no. Erfarenhet är meriterande.Har ett tydligt och relationsskapande ledarskap.Tror på samarbete och gemensamt ansvar för alla elever.Vill vara med och bygga upp en ny skola med höga ambitioner.Vill du vara med på vår resa? Sök tjänsten och bli en del av Tröingeskolans framtid!Du har förmåga att anpassa undervisningen till eleverna och har ett relationellt förhållningssätt. Ditt pedagogiska uppdrag kräver kreativitet och flexibilitet samt att du använder strategier för att främja elevernas motivation, delaktighet och inflytande.Du har lätt att samarbeta och ser arbetslaget som en tillgång. Arbetet ställer även krav på samverkan med övriga kollegor på skolan.Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.Urval och intervjuer sker löpande under rekryteringsprocessen.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2027-01-07  .Före erbjudande om anställning ska du kunna uppvisa utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister och misstankeregister tillsammans med giltig fotolegitimation. Du beställer belastningsregistret via följande länk: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/skola-eller-forskola/Legitimation ska bifogas i ansökan, alt behörighetsgivande examen som berättigar dig till en legitimation.Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk av redan befintlig personal.Du som söker jobb och har skyddade personuppgifter ska kontakta rekryterande chef i annonsen som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess. Du ska inte ansöka digitalt via ansökningslänken.I samband med denna rekrytering undanber vi oss kontakter från rekryteringsföretag och andra annonsörer.

title: Administrativ handläggare (Registrator)
description: Vill du göra nytta för samhället med medborgarens bästa i fokus?Du har nu möjlighet att bli en av oss som administrativ handläggare. Tjänsten består till största delen av arbete som registrator. Varmt välkommen!Förvaltningens administrativa avdelning stöttar förvaltningschef, ledningsgrupp och kärnverksamhet med ekonomi, nämndsadministration, verksamhetsutveckling, beredskap, styrningsfrågor och viss handläggning. På avdelningen är vi tio personer.Tjänsten är placerad på Samhällsbyggnadsförvaltningen som är en av Mjölby kommuns sex förvaltningar, med ansvar för flera centrala samhällsfunktioner. Med cirka 450 medarbetare arbetar vi med planering, utveckling och förvaltning av kommunens infrastruktur, fastigheter, parker och utemiljöer. Förvaltningen ansvarar även för vatten- och avloppsverksamhet, avfallshantering, måltidsservice, lokalvård samt räddningstjänst.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERSom administrativ handläggare (registrator) får du en central roll i det administrativa arbetet för Samhällsbyggnadsnämnden och Byggnämnden. Du arbetar nära nämndsekreteraren, som ansvarar för nämndprocessen. Tillsammans utvecklar ni arbetet med registratur, diarium och arkiv så att förvaltningen kan arbeta rättssäkert och effektivt, utifrån kommunens gemensamma processer och riktlinjer.Du har ett helhetsansvar för inkommande post och nämndernas funktionsbrevlådor, diarium och närarkiv. Du ansvarar för diarieföring, expediering och arkivering av nämndernas ärenden. En stor del av arbetet gäller bygglovsärenden. Där sköter du grannehöranden, publicerarbeslut på kommunens webbplats och administrerar överklaganden. Varje månad rapporterar du underlag för bygglovsstatistik till bland andra Skatteverket och SCB.Du är ett konsultativt stöd för verksamheten i hur handlingar ska hanteras enligt reglerna om allmänna handlingar, offentlighet och sekretess. Du lämnar ut allmänna handlingar och stöttar handläggare i utlämnanden och medverkar i sekretessprövningar. Du utbildar också handläggare i ärendehanteringssystemet.Rollen är bred och du arbetar självständigt. Utöver ovanstående kommer du bland annat:    • vara förvaltningens personuppgiftssamordnare och första kontakt mot dataskyddsombudet i GDPR-frågor    • samordna förvaltningens försäkringar och vara första kontakt i försäkringsfrågor, både internt och externt    • vara ersättare för nämndsekreteraren vid nämndsammanträden och samverkan    • sköta övriga administrativa uppgifter efter verksamhetens behovKVALIFIKATIONERTjänsten har följande krav:     • Eftergymnasial utbildning i informations-, arkivvetenskap, diplomerad registrator, statsvetare eller annat som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdigt    • God dator- och systemvanaVi ser det som meriterande om du har:    • flera års erfarenhet inom området eller funktionen    • erfarenhet av arbete i ärendehanteringssystem och dokumenthantering    • god kännedom om lagstiftning, ex offentlighets- och sekretesslagen (OSL)    • erfarenhet offentlig verksamhetSom person ser vi att du skapar och bibehåller goda relationer, både internt och externt, och samarbetar väl med personer i olika sammanhang och funktioner. Du uttrycker dig tydligt, klart och välstrukturerat i skrift och anpassar dina texter efter målgruppen. Du planerar och organiserar ditt arbete på ett strukturerat sätt genom att sätta upp mål, organisera resurser, följa upp och slutföra aktiviteter. Du är flexibel och anpassar dig lätt till förändrade förutsättningar, samtidigt som du uppmuntrar och stödjer förändringsinitiativ samt anpassar ditt beteende utifrån andra människors behov.Varför ska du jobba i Mjölby Kommun?Vi är stora nog att erbjuda medarbetare goda arbetsvillkor och spännande utvecklingsmöjligheter. Liten nog för nära samarbeten, delaktighet och inflytande. Alldeles lagom, helt enkelt.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet: Tillsvidare.I din ansökan bifogar du relevanta utbildningsintyg och examensbevis som styrker ditt CV. Om du kommer vidare till intervju kommer vi kontrollera din ID-handling. Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess på www.mjolby.se/ledigajobb.Vår kommun är expansiv med cirka 28 900 invånare. Vi har nära till varandra och nära till resten av världen, kommunikationerna är utmärkta. Mjölby kommuns vision sammanfattas i en slogan: Världsvan och hemkär. Världsvan står för öppenhet, nytänkande, vilja att växa och tro på framtiden. Hemkär står för stolthet och glädje över hembygden. Hos oss är det enkelt att leva ett gott liv.

title: PERSONLIG ASSISTENT SIGTUNA
description: Är du kulturintresserad och vill jobba extra 1–2 dagar/kvällar i veckan som personlig assistent?Vår kund är en tonåring som går sista året på Riksgymnasiet för Rörelsehindrade på Kungsholmen och som bor med sin familj i Sigtuna. Han är kulturintresserad, tycker om att spela spel (både digitalt och analogt) samt utforska nya aktiviteter.Ett arbetspass kan se ut på följande sätt: du träffar honom på RGRH, ni hittar på något i stan, kanske käkar något tillsammans och åker till Sigtuna efter det. Där tar ni det lugnt, spelar spel, diskuterar aktuella ämnen. Assistentens roll och erfarenhetPlus i kanten om du är intresserad av Magic the Gathering, Pokémon, Warhammer, Minecraft, Final Fantasy samt andra liknande spel. Ingen tidigare erfarenhet av personlig assistans behövs, det viktigaste är att du är social och att personkemin fungerar. Meriterande erfarenheter    Svenska i tal och skrift.    Spel intresserad. Arbetstid/tjänstgöringsgrad    1-2 dagar/kvällar i veckan (ca 15:00-22:00)    Möjlighet till extrapass finns, dag och kväll. Om lön     Vi tillämpar lön enligt Fremia. Kollektivavtal.    Vi erbjuder friskvård. På FMF Assistans har vi som policy att begära ett utdrag ur belastningsregistret på alla våra anställda då vi värnar om säkerheten för våra kunder. Blir du kallad till intervju vill vi gärna att du tar med aktuellt utdrag som inte får vara mer än ett år gammalt. Ett belastningsregister- för arbete med barn/ ungdom beställer du enklast på https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/-för arbete med personer över 18år/ vuxen beställer du ett belastningsregister på: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/arbete-i-hemmet-med-aldre-och-personer-med-funktionsnedsattning-e-tjanst/Som assistent hos oss på FMF Assistans, vill vi att du precis som vi ska känna stort ansvar och stolthet över ditt uppdrag. Varje dag hjälper våra assistenter våra kunder till en bättre vardag och det är just det personlig assistans handlar om. Vi har lovat våra kunder att göra vårt yttersta för att du som assistent hos oss ska få de bästa förutsättningarna att lyckas i ditt arbete. Varmt välkommen till oss – Vi finns här för våra kunder och våra assistenter.

title: Grundskollärare åk 5-6 i svenska som andra språk
description: Malung-Sälens kommun har ca 10 000 invånare och ligger i natursköna Dalarna, hit kan du flyga till och från vår internationella flygplats i Sälen. Här finns Sälenfjällen som gör oss till världens fjärde största vinterturismdestination. Malung- Sälens fantastiska natur, stora evenemang och upplevelser gör att vi bland annat kan erbjuda dig livskvalitet, möjligheter till ett aktivt friluftsliv och en trygg miljö för barn att växa upp i.Malung-Sälens medarbetare är nyckeln till framgång, därför vill vi skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för ett hållbart arbetsliv, för att du ska trivas, må bra och känna arbetsglädje. Som anställd hos oss erbjuder vi en rad förmåner bland annat:    • Friskvårdsbidrag eller friskvårdtimme där verksamheten tillåter    • Tillsvidareanställd och månadsavlönad personal erbjuds säsongskort till Sälenfjällens anläggningar till förmånligt pris    • Flexibla arbetstider när det är möjligtVälkommen till en arbetsplats där vi gör skillnad tillsammans - med respekt, omtanke och trygghet i fokus.1 plats(er). ARBETSUPPGIFTERUppdraget är som undervisande lärare i framför allt svenska som andra språk, men även andra ämnen kan förekomma, med huvudsakligt fokus på våra elever med annat modersmål. Som grundskollärare på Centralskolan kommer du, tillsammans med ämneskollegor och arbetslaget, att ansvara för att leda det pedagogiska arbetet i enlighet med läroplanens uppdrag. Du planerar, genomför och utvärderar undervisningen med fokus på att skapa en stimulerande och inkluderande lärmiljö för eleverna. På Centralskolan värdesätter vi kollegialt lärande och samarbete. Du kommer att ha ett nära samarbete med dina kollegor för att utveckla undervisningen och skapa bästa möjliga förutsättningar för elevernas lärande. Arbetet innefattar även bedömning och dokumentation av elevernas kunskapsutveckling samt ett aktivt deltagande i skolans utvecklingsarbete. Vi arbetar kontinuerligt med att utveckla tillgängliga lärmiljöer och språk- och kunskapsutvecklande arbetssätt, och vi söker en engagerad lärare som vill vara en del av detta arbete.KVALIFIKATIONERVi söker dig som:·        I första hand är behörig och legitimerad lärare i svenska och svenska som andra språk och har särskild kompetens kring nyanländas lärande ·        är en tydlig ledare i klassrummet som planerar undervisningen utifrån elevernas förutsättningar ·        har ett gott bemötande och en god förmåga att etablera och utveckla relationer till elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor·        förstår att goda relationer främjar hela undervisningssituationen och skapar trygghet för dig och dina elever·        inspireras av ungdomars nyfikenhet och engagemang och bidrar på så sätt till ett aktivt lärande hos varje enskild elev·        är flexibel inför alla vardagliga och långsiktiga förändringar som är en del av det pedagogiska arbetet.Vi lägger särskilt stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och samarbetsförmåga i rekryteringen.Löneform: Månadslön.Löneintervall: Lönespannet för grundskollärare 4-6 ligger inom intervallet 36.000-46.000 kr per månad. Lönen sätts individuellt och differentierat utifrån utbildning och erfarenhet.Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-01-11  .Arbetstid: Dagtid.För att se alla våra pågående rekryteringar, se www.malung-salen.se/ledigajobb.Om du har tidigare erfarenhet från arbete inom vår organisation kan interna referenser komma att tas.Tjänsten tillsätts utifrån att erforderliga politiska beslut fattas. Vi har inför rekryteringsprocessen beslutat om de medieval som ska göras i rekryteringen. Med anledning av detta motsäger vi oss all kontakt gällande annonsering, rekryteringshjälp och bemanningsförslag vänligen, men bestämt.

title: Hemstädare/Home cleaner Spånga- Hemfrid

title: myNanny barnvakt Falsterbo, nanny / barnpassning 1-2 gånger/vecka

description: HEMFRID SÖKER HEMSTÄDARE I VÄRMDÖ – KOM OCH JOBBA MED OSS! ✨Vill du arbeta i ett företag där du får möjlighet att göra skillnad i människors vardag varje dag? title: Digital Design Lead - Digital Journey
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
description: Job DescriptionWHAT YOU’LL DO As Design Lead within Digital Journey, you will shape and manage the end-to-end customer journeys across H&M’s digital channels. You will turn customer insights, user and commercial data into a clear view of the holistic experience, shared priorities across areas and product teams, and measurable outcomes. You will connect the product, design, tech, marketing, retail tech and customer service teams that shape every step of the journey, and manage journeys as living systems.     Establish and drive the vision, goals, roadmap and priorities for customer journeys in line with H&M’s customer and business strategy.     Prioritise improvements to the customer journey and be accountable for journey maps and service blueprints developed together with relevant roles.     Combine customer feedback, research, behavioural data and commercial performance to identify pain points and opportunity spaces, and prioritise improvements with evidence.     Support the definition of journey metrics and KPIs with relevant stakeholders, linking customer outcomes to business value.     Run effective journey governance with clear roles, regular check-ins and early resolution of overlapping or conflicting initiatives.     Coordinate product, design, tech, marketing, retail tech and customer service teams so that changes across channels fit together.     Work with data and tech teams to connect data and tools, enabling continuous monitoring of journey performance.     Partner with design and research to test and iterate solutions, and with orchestration teams to deliver more personalised customer interactions.     Build journey-management capability through shared practices and clear communication.     Demonstrate the business value of journey improvements by connecting them to outcomes such as revenue, churn and repeat purchase.     Align each product team’s contribution with the holistic customer journey and support personalisation of the H&M digital experience. Work closely with Product Managers and Area Business Managers on this.  WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH You will be part of Digital Product Design and work broadly work across product, digital design, technology, marketing, retail tech, customer service, data, analytics and research. The role requires close partnership with senior stakeholders and teams across H&M to create shared direction, resolve dependencies and ensure that improvements across channels deliver one coherent customer experience. You will report to the Journey Manager and, while your organisational home is Design, your scope and collaboration will span the functions that shape the end-to-end customer journey. WHO YOU ARE We are looking for people with…     A background within in customer experience, service design or product management. Experience from other relevant disciplines, such as marketing, technology or data and analytics, is a plus, ideally within a large international organisation.     Proven experience managing end-to-end customer journeys or services across multiple channels, touchpoints and teams.      Experience building journey-management capability in organisations through coaching, training, playbooks, frameworks, practices or communities.     Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence and align product, technology, marketing and other teams without direct authority.     Hands-on experience in journey mapping and service blueprinting, ideally across both digital and physical touchpoints.     Experience combining qualitative research, journey analytics, behavioural data, commercial data and voice-of-customer insight.     Experience defining metrics that connect customer experience with business results such as revenue and churn.     Experience with journey-management tools, data integration, governance and ways of working across siloed teams in agile organisations. We will give special consideration to candidates with experience using AI tools to build, visualise and analyse journeys.     Experience building evidence-based business cases and prioritising journey pain points and opportunities. And people who are…     Customer-centric and able to balance customer needs with product and business goals.     Collaborative and influential, with the ability to create shared direction across functions and levels of seniority.     Clear and transparent communicators who use evidence to make complex topics understandable.     Curious, proactive and open to experimentation, new tools and changing ways of working.     Accountable and action-oriented, with a focus on quality, follow-through and continuous improvement.     Resourceful problem-solvers who can navigate ambiguity, resistance and competing priorities.  Additional InformationWho We AreH&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.   We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.   This role is based out of Stockholm, Sweden. For this we role are unable to provide relocation assistance or visa sponsorship. Applicants must have existing work authorization for the country in which the role is located.  Why You'll Love Working Here At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories and ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. In addition to our global benefits, all our local markets offer different competitive perks and benefits.

employer: Nordea Bank Abp, filial i Sverige
description: Job ID: 6456Core Technology Change & Delivery is seeking an experienced AWS AI Lead Project Leader to drive the delivery and governance of Nordea’s AWS-based AI platform initiatives.In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional delivery across AWS cloud foundations, AI platform capabilities, security, data and engineering. You will help establish governed, scalable and reusable services that enable AI use cases across Nordea, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, security, regulatory and operational requirements.You will translate strategic AI and cloud ambitions into executable plans, coordinate dependencies across multiple technology domains and provide clear, transparent reporting to senior stakeholders. About our teamCore Technology Change & Delivery team is responsible for the Project & Programme management, the delivery & execution and governance of our Change Initiatives  to ensure we meet our commitments in adherence to our Core Tech Operating Model and according to Nordea Delivery Guide.Main responsibilities in this role:     Lead end-to-end delivery of AWS AI platform initiatives, from scope definition and planning through implementation, operational readiness and handover.    Establish and maintain delivery plans covering milestones, dependencies, resources, financials, risks and expected outcomes.    Coordinate delivery across cloud engineering, architecture, security, identity and access management, network, data, platform engineering and business teams.    Drive the evolution of AWS cloud foundations required for scalable AI adoption, including landing-zone capabilities, deployment pipelines, runtime environments, connectivity and platform resilience.    Enable reusable AWS AI services and platform components that support multiple AI use cases and teams across the organisation.    Ensure alignment between business needs, AI use cases, platform capabilities, enterprise architecture and technology roadmaps.    Facilitate governance and approval processes in line with internal policies, regulatory requirements and Nordea’s delivery framework.    Establish clear decision-making forums, delivery standards, operating models and reporting practices.    Proactively manage delivery risks, issues and cross-domain dependencies, escalating when required to maintain predictable execution.    Drive operational readiness, including support models, service ownership, resilience, security, cost management and transition to operations.    Engage senior stakeholders and provide concise, decision-oriented updates on delivery status, risks, financials and required actions.    Promote a strong delivery culture based on ownership, transparency, collaboration and continuous improvement. Who you areYour background and skills include:     Proven track record of leading complex technology programmes in AWS Cloud environments.    Strong experience in AWS platform governance, cloud operating models, landing-zone implementation and platform evolution.    Ability to scope, drive and govern AWS AI platform initiatives that provide reusable capabilities for scalable AI adoption.    Experience leading delivery of AWS-native AI, machine learning and data services, with a clear understanding of how platform capabilities enable business use cases.    Strong understanding of AI enablement platforms, including Generative AI, large language models, agentic or orchestration frameworks and model lifecycle management.    Experience coordinating delivery across architecture, cloud engineering, security, identity and access management, network, data and platform teams.    Ability to translate AI and AWS platform roadmaps into executable programmes, milestones and delivery plans.    Strong understanding of platform-oriented delivery, including shared services, reusable components, automated onboarding and self-service capabilities.    Experience establishing governance frameworks, delivery standards and operating models for large-scale cloud transformations.    Understanding of cloud security, resilience, scalability, operational excellence and cost-management principles.    Strong stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, facilitate decisions and influence cross-functional teams.    Very good financial, resource, risk and dependency-management skills.    Very good analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to turn complex information into clear recommendations and actions.    Advanced presentation and reporting skills, particularly using PowerPoint and Excel.    Excellent communication skills and the ability to bring clarity in both written and verbal communication.    Excellent English skills, both spoken and written.    A proactive, pragmatic and solution-oriented attitude.The role is specifically positioned around Nordea’s AWS AI platform rather than generic multi-cloud delivery. This is consistent with the planned AWS capabilities for enterprise-scale AI adoption and the current focus on a governed, scalable platform supporting AWS ecosystems.If this sounds like you, get in touch!Next steps​Submit your application no later than 16/10/2026.The recruitment process consists of the following steps:    Preliminary CV selection    Online interview with the hiring leader    Background checkFor union information, please contact Finansförbundet at finansforbundet@nordea.se or SACO at SacoNordea@nordea.com.

title: R&D Mechanical Engineer
description: På ABB hjälper vi industrier att bli mer resurseffektiva och renare – och varje person här bidrar till resultaten. Du kommer att få möjlighet att leda, få stöd att växa och kunna vara stolt över den påverkan vi skapar tillsammans. Gå med oss och hjälp till att driva det som driver världen.Denna position rapporterar till:Chapter Lead__Our R&D engineers and scientists develop breakthrough technologies and products that change the way the world works and industries do business. We constantly expand beyond convention, while retaining our focus on delivering solid returns for our customers and shareholdersWe are now looking for several R&D Engineers with a mechanical focus to join one of our agile development teamsYour role and responsibilitiesIn this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s advancement with technology, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your abilities by providing ideas and by being able to work both while managing your own tasks and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.You will be reporting to the R&D Electromechanical Chapter Leader and joining the Load Control Agile Unit based in Västerås, Sweden. This unit operates within ABB Electrification/Smart Power division, dedicated to developing and taking care of our portfolio within low voltage products such as contactors and soft starters.The work model for the role is: OnsiteYou will be mainly accountable for:    Working as an independent and reliable contributor in R&D projects    Performing various tasks in the assigned area related to electromechanical design, from building concepts, gathering requirements to designing, implementing, integrating, testing, technology transfer or maintenance, and operations.    Understanding and applying applicable processes, standards, guidelines, and requirements, including architectural and design constraints.    Managing the achievement of assigned targets (quality, time, scope, cost) and raising and addressing risks.Our team dynamicsYou will be part of an agile development team, working closely with a Product Owner. The Product Owner sets the direction and goals – the team decides how to accomplish them.This role is not task‑driven in the traditional sense. Instead, you will work in a problem‑solving engineering environment.Qualifications for the role    Relevant experience in product development or maintenance is an advantage. We are recruiting across experience levels, from recent graduates to engineers with 5+ years of experience.    A Masters degree in mechanics, mechatronics, engineering physics or equivalent.    Basic knowledge in CAD software and PLM tools is meritorious.    Fluency in English is a requirement, Swedish is a plus.You thrive in situations where you can work freely and do not rely on having every task spelled out ahead of time. You are structured, communicative, and able to define both what needs to be done and what you need from others in order to achieve results. You enjoy working in a collaborative environment while maintaining a high level of initiative.More about usABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions. Recruiting Manager: David Karlén, +46 70 380 70 11, will answer your questions about the position. Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Senad Hujic, +46 730 88 30 06, Unionen: Hannah Norén, +46 706 34 03 46, Ledarna: Lenny Larsson, +46 706 32 85 47. Talent Partner: Medina Jakupovic, +46 72 464 46 98, will answer your questions about the recruitment process.We look forward to reading your application in PDF-format. Last day to apply is 6 December. title: Senior Development Engineer
description: A snapshot of your day Become part of Siemens Energy, where your journey as a Senior Development Engineer begins! Imagine developing your technical skills while building both social and professional networks. You will take responsibility for the lubrication oil system and the technical solutions in assigned development projects, and work closely with project teams to ensure that the products meet specified requirements. Your role will be crucial for delivering development projects on time and within budget, while supporting cross-functional collaboration and mentoring junior team members. With opportunities for personal development and hands-on experience, you will be at the forefront of innovation in energy technology. How You Will Make an Impact* You will own the technical solutions in assigned development projects. * Collaborate closely with project teams and project managers to ensure that the products meet specified requirements in line with the technical roadmap. * Ensure delivery on time and within the agreed scope and budget, and communicate clearly with stakeholders on technical matters. * Support cross-functional collaboration to contribute to the Product Center of Competence. * Mentor and support junior colleagues through review and training, strengthening the team's capabilities.What You Bring* You have a solid base of experience to draw on, which gives you good intuition in your judgments. You are used to evaluation/correcting other engineers' solutions. * You have experience with fluid systems. * You hold a university or master's degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, energy technology or an equivalent education. * You have a good command of Swedish and English, both spoken and written. * You have a strong interest in working with mechanical systems and can help make working methods and processes more efficient. * You work carefully and methodically, with the ability to analyze and critically assess products and solutions. * You are collaborative, driven, have excellent problem-solving skills, and are responsible and flexible, with the patience to dig into technical details. About the TeamOur team consists of two technology areas with a total of 12 members. In the lubrication oil technology area, we currently have two experienced employees, one of whom is the technology area lead, as well as two newly graduated consultants and two consultants based in India. Together we are committed to developing innovative solutions that meet market demands and customer wishes, while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Application Don’t hesitate – apply via https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/en_US/jobs , ID nr 303647 not later than 2026-12-07. Ongoing selection is applied, the role might be filled before last application date. We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers. title: Sales Operations Specialist
description: Would you like to work for a growing company devoted to making a real difference in drug development through groundbreaking imaging? A place that is constantly moving forward, with great science, great people, and an informal atmosphere? Then keep reading.At Antaros Medical, we use advanced imaging methods such as MRI and PET to design and deliver clinical trials for decision-making and differentiation in drug development. We value competence and development as much as ideas and solutions. Relationships and trust are key to success, and we currently have around 160 employees across Sweden and the US.As part of our continued growth, we are now looking for a Sales Operations Specialist to join our commercial team in Sweden.Role overviewAs a Sales Operations Specialist, you will play a key role in supporting our commercial operations and ensuring a seamless customer journey. Working closely with Business Development, Project Management, Finance, Legal, and Operations, you will coordinate proposals, contracts, budgets, and commercial documentation while helping maintain efficient and scalable ways of working.  The position combines proposal development, pricing and budget preparation, contract administration, commercial operations support, and process improvement activities.You will be reporting to our Director Sales Operations, based in Uppsala. This role offers an opportunity to contribute directly to the growth of an international life science company while supporting partnerships with global pharmaceutical and biotech companies.Key responsibilitiesCommercial & Proposal Coordination    Prepare and coordinate proposals, budgets, and commercial documentation.    Support Business Development throughout the customer lifecycle.    Maintain and improve proposal templates, pricing tools, and supporting materials. Contract & Documentation Management    Support administration of contracts, change orders, and related commercial documentation.    Maintain document control, tracking, and compliance with internal processes. Sales Operations & Process Excellence    Support CRM administration, reporting, and commercial data management.    Help improve processes, increase efficiency, and drive operational excellence across functions.Who are we looking for?We are looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and collaborating with a wide range of stakeholders. You are organized, proactive, and detail-oriented, with strong communication skills and a solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy working with numbers, budgets, and complex Excel-based calculations, and you are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.Most importantly, you are motivated by being part of a growing organization where your contribution can make a real difference. Requirements    2-4 years of experience in Sales Operations, Commercial Operations, Proposal Management or similar    Experience from a clinical research organization (CRO), imaging services provider or another project-based service organization.    Experience with pricing, budgeting, and proposal development.    Experience managing and coordinating proposals, budgets, contracts, or other commercial documentation involving multiple stakeholders.    Experience working with commercial agreements such as MSAs, SOWs, Change Orders, or similar contracts.    Bachelor's degree in business administration, Life Sciences, Project Management, or related field.    Strong Excel skills, including working with complex calculations and data, as well as proficiency in Microsoft 365.    Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken. Advantageous    Experience within Life Science, biotech, pharmaceutical, or healthcare environments.    Experience with medical imaging or imaging-based clinical research.    Experience supporting global customers and international commercial teams.    Experience driving process improvements and implementing new ways of working.    Experience working with CPQ (configure/price/quote) and Sales CRM systems Are you interested?If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we'd love to hear from you! Please submit your application, including your CV, via the link below. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.For questions about the role, please contact Malin Hagström, HR Business Partner, at malin.hagstrom@antarosmedical.com.This is a permanent full-time position with a six-month probationary period. Applications are handled exclusively through Teamtailor. The recruitment process is managed directly by Antaros Medical, and we kindly ask recruitment and staffing agencies not to contact us regarding this position. About Antaros MedicalAt Antaros Medical, we combine ground-breaking imaging with profound experience in drug development and deep knowledge of disease mechanisms. We are specialized in cardiorenal & metabolic diseases and oncology. We have a global network of collaboration partners and customers, including both Big Pharma and Biotechs, and several European collaboration initiatives such as Innovative Medicines Initiative (IMI) and COST.Antaros Medical has delivered small complex, mechanistic studies as well as multi-center clinical trials worldwide utilizing our innovative imaging methods. Our global headquarter and imaging Corelab are based in Sweden, and we have recently opened a subsidiary in the US. If you want to find out more about our company, go to our website: www.antarosmedical.comOur culture is our people, and our values makes us everything that we are. Please feel free to have a look upon our Culture Handbook to get to know us even more: Our culture - Antaros Medical.

title: HIL Testning

description: Why this job is for you  Are you interested in developing the automotive industry and want to contribute to a collaborative and forward-thinking team? Preferably in the automotive- or any other safety-critical industry.    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to diagnose complex system interactions between software and hardware.Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams Ready to Make an Impact and Build a Career to be Proud of:Functional Safety is a multidisciplinary domain contributing to developing safer electronic products for our society. You will have a personal development plan, and we will help you build your career through close collaboration and teamwork. Allowing you to learn and work with some of the most skilled professionals in the industry. Practical information This is a permanent position with a six-month probationary period, based at our office inLindholmsallen 2 Gothenburg. Business travel to our clients may be required. The start date is as soon as possible or as agreed upon.Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 2026-12-14. description: Make Nordic parcel logistics work better for customers and operations. Turn complex product needs into practical improvements.PostNord is developing its Nordic parcel portfolio to create customer value, support profitable growth and harmonise services across markets. As a Nordic Product Specialist, you will play an important role in making these improvements work in practice within your assigned product area. You will combine your understanding of logistics and operational parcel flows with product expertise to improve processes, systems and services across the Nordics.The position offers the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues across functions and Nordic markets, turning complex requirements into clear specifications, reliable data and practical improvements.Purpose, Offer and BenefitsThe position offers a flexible hybrid workplace in a collaborative environment where colleagues support each other in reaching shared goals. Independent working methods are encouraged, alongside opportunities for professional development and career growth.Benefits include:    The opportunity to work in a Nordic and flexible environment    Good insurance and occupational pension conditions    Wellness allowance and access to office gym and swimming pool, depending on office location    Employee benefits through PostNord´s employee foundation, PostNord Plus    Employment according to a collective agreement Your ResponsibilitiesAs a Nordic Product Specialist, you will turn complex requirements into clear specifications, reliable product data and practical implementation support. Using your product expertise and understanding of logistics operations, you will help improve products, streamline launches and simplify everyday work.The role will focus on either C2C/Recommerce or International & Customs, including international parcel flows, import and export. Responsibilities will be adapted to the assigned product area, customer journeys and operational needs.Your main responsibilities include:    Build expertise in product logic, services, terms, customer needs and logistics processes.    Support Product Managers with insights for roadmaps, lifecycle decisions, portfolio optimisation and product improvements.     Maintain clear product specifications, rules, terms input, operational requirements and documentation.    Translate operational needs into system requirements in close collaboration with IT and Operations.    Ensure accurate, consistent product data across systems and channels, and make product knowledge accessible to stakeholders.    Support launches, changes, migrations and phase-outs through readiness checks, implementation follow-up, issue resolution and hypercare.    Coordinate implementation across Operations, IT, Customer Service, Commercial, Legal, CX, Pricing and Nordic markets.    Share product knowledge through guidance, internal communication and change support.    Capture and escalate local needs, implementation issues and post-launch feedback to support Nordic product development and prioritisation.The Bigger PictureThe position is part of PostNord´s Nordic product organisation, where operational understanding and collaboration across different functions are essential to improving parcel services.The Nordic Product Specialist reports to the relevant Manager Solutions Area and works closely with Product Managers and colleagues across functions and Nordic markets. The role provides insight into how logistics processes, systems and customer needs connect across the Nordic network.The position can be based at one of PostNord´s main offices in Solna, Helsinki, Oslo or Copenhagen. A hybrid working model applies, with three days per week at the office. Some travel within the Nordics is expected, particularly when building relationships and gaining a deeper understanding of operations. Our ExpectationsThe role is suited to someone who is curious, business minded and practical in their approach, combining product expertise with analytical thinking and attention to detail. The ability to challenge unclear logic, simplify complexity and connect people across Nordic markets is important. Taking ownership and following through until changes work in practice will be key to succeeding in the position.Relevant experience from logistics, preferably parcel logistics, or from a role involving operational logistics flows and process improvements is important. Suitable backgrounds may include product management, operations, customer service, sales support, process development or a comparable area.Relevant skills and experience include:    Understanding of logistics operations, operational processes and how parcel flows connect with systems and services.    Ability to structure complex product information, documentation, requirements and master data.    Understanding of how products, operations, systems, channels and market implementation connect.    Analytical, solution oriented thinking that turns product knowledge into practical improvements.    Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills to move work forward across functions.    Good working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, including the ability to analyse information and present findings clearly.    Fluency in spoken and written English and at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Danish, Norwegian or Finnish. Experience from a Nordic or matrix organisation, product launches, migrations or change initiatives involving different functions is an advantage. Relevant experience within international logistics and customs, or C2C/Recommerce, is also valuable depending on the assigned product area. A university or college degree is an advantage but not a requirement. Interested?We work with TNG in this recruitment process. If you are interested in this position, apply right now! The selection process is ongoing and the position can be filled before the last apply-date. If you have any questions, please contact the recruiter.

title: PhD position in Agricultural Science
description: Department of Biosystems and TechnologyThird-cycle subject area: Agricultural SciencePhD Project: Sustainability Assessment of Agroecological Farming SystemsDescription of the doctoral projectThe PhD project is a collaboration between the Animal Centred Environments group and the Horticultural and Agroecological Systems (HAS) subject area within the Department. The doctoral research will focus on sustainability assessment of agroecological livestock farming systems, drawing on expertise across both groups and involving collaboration with researchers, farmers and other stakeholders across Europe and Africa through ALASTRA and STRONG MCSA.About the positionHow can sustainability assessment support the transition to more resilient and sustainable farming systems? This PhD project will investigate how multi-criteria approaches can capture the environmental, economic and social performance of agroecological farming systems, identify synergies and trade-offs, and support decisions by farmers and other agricultural stakeholders.The doctoral student will work primarily within ALASTRA (Agroecology Living Labs in Africa: Redefining the Role of Animals in Food Systems for Climate Action and Sustainability), an EU-funded Horizon Europe project. ALASTRA brings together researchers, farmers and other stakeholders to co-design and evaluate agroecological livestock farming practices through living labs in Kenya, Tanzania, Tunisia and Zambia. SLU leads the development of the holistic assessment framework, including the selection of indicators and the design of sampling and data collection protocols.The doctoral student will contribute to developing, adapting and evaluating this framework. The research will draw on approaches such as the Global Farm Metric and established agroecological assessment tools, including OASISm the PG tool and TAPE.The doctoral student will also contribute to STRONG MCSA, an EU-funded Erasmus+ project that strengthens agricultural stakeholders’ capacity to use multi-criteria sustainability assessment (MCSA). These activities will provide a complementary foundation for the doctoral research in ALASTRA.The doctoral project will combine literature-based research, development and evaluation of assessment methods, quantitative and qualitative data analysis, and engagement with farmers, advisors and researchers. The student will collaborate with partners in Europe and Africa, contribute to project workshops and scientific publications, and communicate findings to academic and practitioner audiences. International visits and participation in project activities may form part of the doctoral studies.RequirementsTo meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).The following specific entry requirements apply: For the subject of agricultural science, the applicant must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.Your profileRequired qualifications    A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Agroecology, Agricultural Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Science, or a related field    A good understanding of agricultural systems, agroecology and sustainability challenges    Experience in research methods and quantitative data analysis, demonstrated through a degree project or equivalent work    Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken    Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an international, multidisciplinary teamDesirable qualifications    Knowledge or experience of Multi Criteria Sustainability Assessment (MCSA), Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), indicator development or farm assessment tools    Experience with literature reviews and the comparative analysis of methods or tools    Experience with statistical analysis and software such as R, or with qualitative research methods    Knowledge of livestock farming, grazing systems, soil health or agroecological transitions    Experience collaborating with farmers, advisors or other agricultural stakeholders, including participatory research or workshops    Experience working in African agricultural contexts or other international research settings    Interest or experience in developing training resources and communicating research to practitioners    Good communication skills in Swedish or another Scandinavian language    A valid car driver’s licence recognized in SwedenAbout usAt the Department of Biosystems and Technology, we explore interactions between soil, plants, animals, the environment, climate, and humans in systems for sustainable food production and renewable raw materials.More information about the department on title: Domain Architect Finance & Supply Chain
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Domain Architect Finance &amp; Supply Chain--- Domain Architect Finance \& Supply Chain========================================vVARDIS is a Swiss\-based oral health company founded by Dr. Haley and Dr. Goly Abivardi, dentists, innovators, and award\-winning entrepreneurs. vVARDIS is the result of a combined 30 years of dental and entrepreneurial experience, and 20 years of laboratory and clinical research paired with the creative vision of its founders. At vVARDIS, we are committed to delivering innovative solutions that enhance oral health and well\-being, inspired by the vision of our founders to foster preventive rather than reparative dentistry. At the heart of our Company lies its patented, revolutionary biomimetic peptide technology. Scientifically proven in over 200 publications, this unique technology can treat early caries through enamel regeneration, offering a non\-invasive, pain\-free solution for patients of all ages. Our portfolio includes oral health products for dental professionals, patients, and consumers, all based on our proprietary technology.We value our people and believe in fostering a positive and collaborative work environment, grounded in our core values of innovation, excellence, integrity, and empathy.We are located in Zug, Switzerland, with operations in Europe and the US. Join us on this exciting journey. **Purpose:**As Domain Architect Finance \& Supply Chain, you will own the design and governance of our ERP landscape across Finance and Supply Chain. You will translate business needs into scalable, compliant solutions, challenge designs where needed, and ensure changes meet both operational and regulatory requirements. Working across Finance, Supply Chain, QA/RA, IT and external partners, you will help build an ERP environment that is reliable, controlled and ready to scale with vVARDIS.**Key responsibilities*** Own the ERP requirements. Turn what Finance and Supply Chain ask for into clear, prioritized requirements with acceptance criteria, and say no when a request would break a control or the design.* Act as the design authority. Every change from a partner, developer or internal team passes your review before it goes live.* Get Finance, Supply Chain, QA/RA (Quality Assurance / Regulatory Affairs) and IT to agree on one target design and roadmap.* Steer our implementation partners: scope, estimates, change requests and delivery quality. Accept work against criteria, not against effort spent.* Own SOX (Sarbanes\-Oxley) IT general controls in the ERP: change management, segregation of duties in security roles, and key reports finance can rely on.* Keep GxP\-relevant ( Practice regulations) processes validated. Take a risk\-based approach under GAMP 5 ( Automated Manufacturing Practice) with records that meet EU GMP ( Manufacturing Practice) Annex 11 and FDA 21 CFR Part 11\.* Make sure Microsoft’s mandatory service updates go through regression testing without weeks of manual revalidation.**Required Qualifications \& Experience*** You have led D365 Finance and Supply Chain, or a comparable ERP, as an architect, solution lead or lead consultant, and have defended at least one SOX or GxP audit.* You know Finance and Supply Chain processes well enough to challenge a partner’s design, from purchase to payment and from receiving goods to the close.* You can spot a change that runs without errors but posts to the wrong ledger account or bypasses an approval.* You write requirements a partner can’t misread, and acceptance criteria they can’t argue with.* You can hand an inspector the validation evidence for any change in minutes, because the process produced it, not because someone assembled it for the audit.* You use AI tools in your daily work, for example to analyse requirements, review configuration or draft test cases, and know where they need a human check.* You can tell a partner their estimate is wrong without starting a war.* You work fluently in English.**Key Competencies / Soft Skills*** Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, processes and deadlines while maintaining alignment with other dependencies on priorities and expected deliverables* Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to documentation and record\-keeping, with ownership of the accuracy and completeness of work* Clear and concise written and verbal communication, with strong listening skills and the ability to clarify requirements and expectations before proceeding* Openness to feedback, with the ability to translate it into practical improvements and adapt working methods when needed* A diplomatic and collaborative approach to cross\-functional work, with the ability to influence without direct authority and follow up effectively with process owners* Proactive and able to work independently, while recognizing when to seek guidance, flag risks, or escalate issues* Sound judgment and a constructive approach to problem\-solving, with the ability to consider different perspectives, raise concerns, and follow through on agreed decisions and actions* An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret data and translate it into meaningful metrics and actionable insights* Adaptability to changing priorities and business or regulatory requirements, while maintaining quality and a continuous improvement mindset**Your Personality*** You like order. A vague requirement or a change without test evidence bothers you until it’s fixed.* You own outcomes, not tasks. When a partner delivers the wrong thing, you fix the process that let it happen, not just the ticket.* You’re structured without being bureaucratic. A control has to protect something real, or you argue to remove it.* You hold your position with a partner, the CFO or QA when the evidence supports you, and you change it when it doesn’t.* You learn fast and enjoy it, whether it’s a new regulation, a Microsoft release or a process you’ve never seen.* You know your work ends up in a product patients use and in numbers the auditors sign. That’s why you do it right, not why you’re nervous about it.**Apply**No cover letter. Send one page about an ERP change you steered from request to go\-live. Tell us how you defined and accepted it, which control or validation step you built in, and how you handled a change or design that presented a compliance or audit risk.![vVARDIS AG]()* vVARDIS AG  Gubelstrasse 24  6300 Zug*jidc6017f9jm jit1147jm jiy26jm

title: PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 %
description: Curious about the roles of households in the new Swiss Local Electricity Community regulation and how they evolve at the interface of politics and the energy sector? PhD candidate: Role of Households in Local Electricity Communities 100 % \*\*What you will be responsible for\*\* Since January 2026, so\\-called Local Electricity Communities (LEG) enable Swiss households to buy and sell PV electricity within their neighbourhood. Whether LEGs will become established and make a substantial contribution to Switzerland's energy targets remains to be seen in the coming years. This is being investigated by the SFOE\\-funded research project "LEAP" lead by the ZHAW in partnership with the University of Lausanne and Swisspower AG. The PhD position advertised focuses on the evolving roles, expectations and experiences of the key stakeholders in the LEGs (households, LEG service providers and energy suppliers), with a particular focus on the households who join an LEG. \* Work towards a PhD (co\\-supervised by the University of Lausanne) within the LEAP project \* Plan and carry out surveys and interviews for your data collection \* Analyse and present findings in the form of academic publications \* Collaborate with the project team and beyond ( , communicating with partners, presenting research results at scientific conferences, etc.) \* Provide ad hoc support to the Institute of Innovation \\\& Entrepreneurship in teaching ( supervising student projects) or other research projects \*\*What makes you a great fit\*\* \* You hold a an excellent Master's degree in Management, Environmental Sciences, Social Sciences, or similarly fitting field ( , renewable energy). \* In addition to fluency in German and/or French (a requirement for data collection), you have an excellent command of written and spoken English. \* You have solid knowledge in quantitative and/or qualitative research methods ( designing and analysing surveys or semi\\-structured interviews). \* You have a strong interest to do societally and scientifically relevant work. \* You enjoy independence and autonomy, and can take responsibility for your own PhD thesis, as well as for the related project objectives. Nonetheless, you know the value of collaboration and are keen to contribute to the exchange of ideas and results with the project's research and practice partners. \* Your have a clear and open communication style, and bring curiosity and enthusiasm to the team. \* Practical experience in interdisciplinary or transdisciplinary project settings, as well as in the field of energy (particularly regarding energy communities), would be a welcome addition to your profile. \*\*About your workplace\*\* The ZHAW Zurich University of Applied Sciences is the largest university of applied sciences in German\\-speaking Switzerland, with around 15,000 students, more than 11,000 continuing education participants and over 3,700 employees. We are committed to building diverse teams in order to promote equality and inclusion. We offer a flexible working environment that can be adapted to your individual circumstances. \*\*School of Management and Law\*\* The ZHAW School of Management and Law (SML) is one of the largest business schools in Switzerland with around 9,500 students. It is the only university of applied sciences in the country that is included in renowned rankings published by the business newspaper "Financial Times" and is accredited by AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA \\- labels for high quality standards in teaching, research and further education. The internationally recognized bachelor's and master's degree programs, cooperative PhD programs and the numerous continuing education offerings are scientifically sound, interdisciplinary and practice oriented. The SML maintains numerous collaborations with over 190 selected partner universities worldwide. \*\*\[ZHAW Institute for Innovation and Entrepreneurship\](\< \>)\*\* The Institute conducts research, teaches and provides consultancy in the key areas of business innovation, innovation systems and entrepreneurship. One of our key areas of focus is the transformation of the energy system, in close collaboration with various stakeholders at the interface of research, politics and society. \*\*Any questions? title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Collaborateur-trice scientifique---Collaborateur\-trice scientifique=================================Vous aimeriez contribuer au développement du canton de Fribourg, avez l'esprit du service public, et cherchez un poste varié qui fait sens ? A l'Etat de Fribourg vous travaillerez pour le plus grand employeur du canton. A l'écoute, dynamique et tournée vers l'avenir, l'administration cantonale, et ses établissements, sont au service de la population fribourgeoise.Collaborateur\-trice scientifique================================= **Qui sommes\-nous?**Enseignement, recherche, emplois, événements: l'Université de Fribourg est un espace d'innovations et un moteur important pour la vie économique et culturelle de la région. Elle attire des étudiant\-e\-s et des chercheur\-euse\-s en provenance de toute la Suisse et du monde entier, elle marque le quotidien de la cité bilingue de Fribourg, depuis sa fondation en 1889\.The Knowledge and Technology Transfer Service of the University of Fribourg supports researchers in industry collaborations, the protection and commercialization of research results, and the creation of spin\-offs. **Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?**Nous misons sur la complémentarité des compétences et la variété des perspectives car c'est la diversité des parcours et des profils qui fait la force de l'Etat de Fribourg. Nous favorisons la conciliation vie professionnelle et vie privée et les conditions de travail flexibles. title: Macro Commodities Options Strategist
description: OverviewBalyasny Asset Management (BAM) is seeking a highly sophisticated, buy-side-proven Options Strategist to join a macro portfolio management team based in Switzerland.ResponsibilitiesTrade Execution: Partner directly with the Portfolio Manager to translate high-conviction macro, commodity, and equity views into highly efficient options and derivatives structures. Experience executing sector baskets & determining optimal trade structures (e.g., spreads, outrights) to maximize capital efficiency and convexity.Greeks Optimization: Systematically monitor and manage the portfolio's options-specific risks, with a rigorous focus on theta bleed/decay, volatility surface dynamics, and trade timing.Downside & Tail-Hedging: Design, implement, and run robust tail-hedging and downside-protection frameworks. Ensure the portfolio is structurally insulated against tail risk, correlation breakdowns, and extreme market shocks.Portfolio Construction: Proactively identify and monitor "blind spots" within the book, including hidden factor exposures, correlation breakdowns under stress, and liquidity gaps across various market regimes.Drawdown Management: Formulate and manage drawdown mitigation processes, ensuring the net directionality of the book is dynamically adjusted and protected during periods of heightened volatility or performance drawdowns.Cross-Asset Market Trade Idea Generation: Help generated high quality, high conviction trade ideas across sectors and asset classes; Equities, Commodities, and FX to identify relative-value & directional opportunities.RequirementsOptions & Volatility Expertise: An exceptional understanding of option pricing, volatility dynamics, and derivatives structures. While cross-asset options experience is highly preferred (specifically straddling Equities, Commodities, and Precious Metals), we are open to specialists from any asset class who demonstrate world-class derivatives expertise.Seasoned Buy-Side Experience: The ideal candidate must possess significant, battle-tested hedge fund or proprietary trading firm experience. You must have lived through multiple market cycles, navigated severe drawdowns, and structurally managed risk in real-world, high-stress environments.Portfolio Construction & Risk Analytics: Strong quantitative capabilities with the ability to model complex, multi-asset portfolios, identify liquidity gaps, and stress-test assets during correlation breakdown periods.PM Collaboration: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills. You must be able to challenge assumptions, present complex risk trade-offs to the Portfolio Manager, and work hand-in-hand to optimize the book's risk-reward profile.Education: A degree in Finance, Mathematics, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline; or advanced degree a plusLocation: Ideally based in, or willing to relocate to Zug or Geneva, Switzerland.What We OfferCompetitive compensation, inclusive of performance-based bonuses.Comprehensive benefits package.Pathways for professional growth and career development.A dynamic and supportive work environment where innovation and creativity are encouraged.Opportunity to be part of building a great business where your efforts are recognized and valued.
